title: Alleged rebel leader killed in Colombia as president targets armed groups
english: Colombian security forces recently killed Hernando Forero Mosquera, a leader of a dissident rebel faction, during a military operation. This action follows the inauguration of President Abelardo de la Espriella, who has pledged a tough military stance against illegal armed groups. His approach marks a significant shift from the previous administration's failed peace negotiation strategy as the government works to curb ongoing violence.
amharic: የኮሎምቢያ የፀጥታ ኃይሎች በቅርቡ ባደረጉት ወታደራዊ ኦፕሬሽን የአመጸኛ ቡድን መሪ የሆኑትን ሄርናንዶ ፎሬሮ ሞስኬራን ገድለዋል። ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው በህገ-ወጥ ታጣቂ ቡድኖች ላይ ጠንካራ ወታደራዊ እርምጃ እንደሚወስዱ ቃል የገቡት አዲሱ ፕሬዝዳንት አቤላርዶ ዴ ላ ኤስፕሪኤላ ስልጣን ከያዙ በኋላ ነው። መንግስት በአገሪቱ እየተባባሰ የመጣውን ግጭት ለመግታት፣ የቀድሞው አስተዳደር ሲከተለው የነበረውን ያልተሳካ የሰላም ድርድር ስትራቴጂ በመቀየር ጠንካራ አቋም መውሰድ ጀምሯል።
oromo: Humnoonni nageenyaa Kolombiyaa duula waraanaatiin hogganaa garee finxaaleyyii kan ta'an Hernando Forero Mosquera ajjeesaniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame pirezidaantii haaraa Abelardo de la Espriella erga aangoo qabatanii booda yoo ta'u, isaanis gareewwan hidhatan irratti tarkaanfii cimaa fudhachuuf waadaa galaniiru. Mootummaan rakkoo nageenyaa biyyattii keessatti bal'inaan mul'atu to'achuuf, mala marii nagaa kan durii dhiisuun tarkaanfii waraanaatti gadi bahuun isaa ni beekama.

title: Gaza honours Al Jazeera’s Anas al-Sharif and Mohammed Qraiqea
english: Journalists in Gaza recently held a memorial vigil to honor Al Jazeera reporter Anas al-Sharif, cameraman Mohammed Qraiqea, and other Palestinian media professionals. This event marked one year since they lost their lives during an Israeli attack. The gathering served as a tribute to their dedication and sacrifice while reporting from the conflict zone.
amharic: በጋዛ የሚገኙ ጋዜጠኞች የአልጀዚራ ዘጋቢ አናስ አል-ሻሪፍን፣ ካሜራማን መሀመድ ቅራኢቃን እና ሌሎች በጦርነቱ የተገደሉ የጋዜጣ ባለሙያዎችን ለማሰብ የተቃውሞ ሰልፍ አድርገዋል። ዝግጅቱ እነዚህ ጋዜጠኞች በእስራኤል ጥቃት ከተገደሉ አንድ ዓመት መሙላቱን ለማስታወስ የተዘጋጀ ነው። ተሳታፊዎቹ ለሙያቸው የከፈሉትን መስዋዕትነት በማውሳት አክብረዋቸዋል።
oromo: Gaazexeessitoonni Gaazaatti argaman gabaasaa Al-Jazeera Anas al-Sharif, kaameraa-manii Mohammed Qraiqea fi hojjettoota miidiyaa biroo waraana kanaan du'an yaadachuuf sagantaa yaadannoo gaggeessaniiru. Sagantaan kun gaazexeessitoonni kun erga haleellaa Israa'el irratti du'anii waggaa tokko guutuu isaa kan yaadachiisu dha. Hirmaattoonni gaazexeessitoonni kun hojii isaaniif aarsaa guddaa kafalan kana kabajaafi yaadannoon yaadatan.

title: Why choosing low-fat dairy is not necessarily better for your health
english: Recent research challenges the long-standing belief that low-fat dairy is healthier for weight and heart health. A University of Toronto study found that consuming three servings of full-fat dairy daily does not lead to weight gain or negative changes in cholesterol levels. In fact, participants who ate full-fat dairy saw improvements in blood pressure and increased their intake of essential nutrients like calcium and protein.

Kana irra darbee, namoonni aannan cooma qabu fayyadaman dhiibbaa dhiigaa isaanii fooyyessuufi akkaataa kalisiyumii fi pirootiinii fayyadamuu isaanii dabaluuf gargaareera.

title: Nigel Farage vows to deport foreign criminals from UK prisons
english: Nigel Farage, leader of the Reform UK party, has promised to expel all non-British convicts from the country's prison system if his party wins an election. These individuals would either be returned to their home nations or relocated to third-party countries like El Salvador or Kosovo. This proposal is part of the party's platform to address foreign offenders currently serving sentences in the UK.
amharic: የሪፎርም ዩኬ ፓርቲ መሪ ናይጄል ፋራጅ ምርጫ ካሸነፉ በብሪታንያ እስር ቤቶች የሚገኙ የውጭ ሀገር ዜግነት ያላቸውን ወንጀለኞች በሙሉ ከሀገሪቱ እንደሚያስወጡ ቃል ገብተዋል። እነዚህ ግለሰቦች ወደ መጡበት ሀገር እንዲመለሱ ወይም እንደ ኮሶቮ እና ኤል ሳልቫዶር ባሉ ሌሎች ሀገራት እንዲዛወሩ ይደረጋል። ይህ እቅድ በብሪታንያ እስር ቤቶች ውስጥ የሚገኙ የውጭ ሀገር ወንጀለኞችን ቁጥር ለመቀነስ ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Hogganaan paartii Reform UK, Najel Faaraaj, yoo filannoo mo'atan namoota yakka raawwatanii mana hidhaa Britaan keessa jiran kan biyya alaa hunda biyyattii keessaa baasuuf waadaa galaniiru. Namoonni kunneen gara biyya isaanii akka deebi'an ykn gara biyyoota sadaffaatti akka ergaman yaada dhiyeessaniiru; fakkeenyaaf biyyoota akka Kosovoo ykn El Saalvaadoor. Karoorri kun namoota biyya alaa mana hidhaa Britaan keessa jiran ilaalchisee yaada paartichaa kan ibsuudha.

title: One million evacuated as Typhoon Dolphin pummels east China: What we know
english: Typhoon Dolphin has struck eastern China with high winds and heavy rainfall, resulting in the emergency evacuation of over one million residents. The storm caused significant transportation disruptions, including the cancellation of many flights in Shanghai and widespread flooding. Although the typhoon is gradually weakening, authorities remain concerned about ongoing landslide and flood risks as the weather system moves inland.

oromo: Obomboleettiin Dolphin jedhamu Chaayinaa bahaatti waan gaheef, namoonni miiliyoona tokko ol ta'an iddoo jireenya isaanii gadhiisuuf dirqamaniiru. Obomboleettiin kun bakka hedduutti lolaa fi qilleensa cimaa uumuun, balalii xiyyaaraa keessumaa Shaanghaay keessatti akka dhaabatu godheera. Obomboleettiin kun yeroo ammaa hir'achaa jiraatus, gara keessa biyyatti yammuu socho'u lolaa fi lafti akka hin sigigineef mootummaan ummata akeekkachiiseera.

title: Has the army turned the page on control of western Sudan?
english: The Sudanese military and allied armed groups have recently secured key strategic victories against the Rapid Support Forces (RSF) in western Darfur. By successfully defending the Bir Saliba region and disrupting border supply routes near Chad, government forces are increasing pressure on the RSF's stronghold in el-Geneina. Furthermore, the death of a prominent RSF commander has significantly weakened the paramilitary group's leadership in this critical area.
amharic: የሱዳን ጦር እና አጋር ሃይሎች በምዕራብ ዳርፉር በሚገኙ የራፒድ ሰፖርት ፎርሶች (RSF) ላይ ወሳኝ ድሎችን አስመዝግበዋል። የቢር ሳሊባ አካባቢን በመቆጣጠር እና የድንበር አቅርቦት መስመሮችን በማስተጓጎል የሱዳን መንግሥት ሃይሎች በኤል-ገኔና ላይ ያላቸውን ተጽዕኖ እያጠናከሩ ይገኛሉ። በተጨማሪም፣ አንድ ከፍተኛ የRSF አዛዥ መገደል የፓራሚሊታሪ ቡድኑን አመራር በእጅጉ ያዳከመው ሆኗል።
oromo: Raayyaan ittisa biyya Sudaanii fi gareewwan isaanii waliin hiriiran naannoo Daarfur dhiyaatti injifannoo guddaa garee Rapid Support Forces (RSF) irratti galmeessaniiru. Humnoonni mootummaa naannoo Bir Saliba to'annoo isaanii jala galchuu fi daandiiwwan dhiyeessii daangaa gubbaa cufuudhaan, dhiibbaa RSF irratti jiru cimsaa jiru. Kana malees, ajajaan RSF cimaan tokko waraana keessatti ajjeefamuun isaanii, garee kanaaf miidhaa guddaa fi duubatti hafoo ta'eera.

title: Former MP opens fire in Thailand’s second shooting within days
english: A former member of parliament shot and killed a retired police officer outside a government building in Nonthaburi, Thailand. This violent event took place only three days after a separate tragedy where a teenager killed multiple people in the same province. These back-to-back shooting incidents have caused significant concern in the region.
amharic: በታይላንድ ኖንታቡሪ ግዛት የቀድሞ የፓርላማ አባል በመንግስት ቢሮ ውጪ በከፈቱት ተኩስ አንድ የቀድሞ የፖሊስ መኮንን ተገድለዋል። ይህ አሳዛኝ ክስተት የተከሰተው አንድ የ14 ዓመት ታዳጊ በተመሳሳይ ግዛት ስምንት ሰዎችን ከገደለ ከሶስት ቀናት በኋላ ነው። እነዚህ ተከታታይ የተኩስ ልውውጦች በአካባቢው ከፍተኛ ስጋት ፈጥረዋል።

title: ‘Long-range sanctions’: Ukraine hopes strikes cause Russia fear and losses
english: Ukraine is increasingly using its own domestically produced long-range drones to strike critical infrastructure, such as oil refineries and factories, deep inside Russian territory. By bypassing previous restrictions from Western allies, these frequent night missions aim to pressure Russia by disrupting its industrial capacity and creating widespread instability. Commanders indicate that these drone operations are now highly coordinated and can reach targets as far away as Siberia.

title: Video: Yemen's Houthis attack port in Mocha
english: At least 11 individuals lost their lives following a Houthi strike on the Yemeni port city of Mocha this Sunday. The incident occurred shortly after a separate drone operation targeted a Saudi oil facility located along the Red Sea. These violent events highlight the ongoing instability and conflict currently affecting the region.
amharic: እሁድ ዕለት በየመን ሞቻ ወደብ ከተማ በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በተፈፀመ ጥቃት ቢያንስ 11 ሰዎች ሕይወታቸው አልፏል። ጥቃቱ የተፈፀመው ቀደም ብሎ በሳውዲ አረቢያ የነዳጅ ማጣሪያ ላይ ድሮን ጥቃት ከተሰነዘረ በኋላ ነው። እነዚህ ድርጊቶች በአካባቢው እየተባባሰ የመጣውን የፀጥታ ቀውስ ያሳያሉ።
oromo: Dilbata darbe magaalaa buufata doonii Mocha kan Yamanitti haleellaa garee Huutii qaqqabeen namoonni 11 lubbuun isaanii darbeera. Haleellaan kun kan raawwatame erga kanaan dura buufata qulqulleessa boba'aa Saudii kan galaana diimaa irra jiru irratti haleellaan doonii malee (drone) gaggeeffamee booda. Gochootni kun rakkoo nageenyaa naannichatti hammaachaa jiru kan agarsiisanidha.

title: UN expresses 'deep concern' about Houthi attacks
english: The UN envoy for Yemen, Hans Grundberg, has raised alarms following a Houthi attack on the Red Sea port of Mocha that resulted in dozens of deaths and injuries. He urged all sides to remain calm and warned that the violence must stop to allow for a lasting political solution. This incident highlights a major escalation in military activity within the region.
amharic: የተባበሩት መንግስታት የየመን ልዩ መልዕክተኛ ሃንስ ግሩንድበርግ በሞቻ ወደብ ላይ በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በተፈጸመ ጥቃት የደርሰውን ጉዳት በጥብቅ አውግዘዋል። ጥቃቱ ሰባት ሰዎችን ሲገድል ከሰላሳ በላይ ለሚሆኑት ደግሞ የአካል ጉዳት አድርሷል። መልዕክተኛው በግጭቱ የተሳተፉ ወገኖች መረጋጋትን እንዲመርጡ ጥሪ በማቅረብ፣ ዘላቂ ሰላም ሊመጣ የሚችለው በፖለቲካዊ ውይይት ብቻ መሆኑን አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Ergamtooni gamtaa mootummootaa kan Yemen, Hans Grundberg, haleellaa gareen Houthi buufata doonii Mocha irratti raawwateen lubbuun namoota torba darbuu fi namoonni soddoma ol madaa'uu isaaniitiin gadda guddaa ibsaniiru. Gaggeessaan kun walitti bu'iinsi kun furmaata siyaasaa kan gaafatu ta'uu ibsuun, gareen hundi tasgabbii akka godhatan dhaamaniiru. Haleellaan kun naannichatti waraanni daran hammaachaa dhufuu isaa kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Zionism has warped the lexicon, so words are now convenient weapons
english: French activist Elias d'Imzalene has faced legal consequences and financial restrictions for using the term 'intifada,' which authorities reinterpreted as a call for violence. This reflects a broader trend where pro-Israel groups are successfully redefining specific words to label dissent as harmful or antisemitic. Such efforts, including lobbying institutions like the British Museum to remove references to Palestine, aim to control public discourse and delegitimize historical accounts of the region.
amharic: የፈረንሣይ አክቲቪስት ኤሊያስ ዲምዛሌን 'ኢንቲፋዳ' የሚለውን ቃል በመጠቀማቸው የህግ እና የገንዘብ ማዕቀብ ተጥሎባቸው ነበር፤ ባለስልጣናት ቃሉን የጥቃት ጥሪ እንደሆነ ተርጉመውታል። ይህ ክስተት እስራኤልን የሚደግፉ ቡድኖች የተቃውሞ ድምፆችን እንደ ጥላቻ ንግግር ለመፈረጅ ቃላትን እየቀየሩ መሆኑን ያሳያል። የብሪቲሽ ሙዚየም የፍልስጤምን ስም እንዲያነሳ ከመጠየቅ ጀምሮ የሚደረጉ እነዚህ ጥረቶች፣ የህዝብን ግንዛቤ ለመቆጣጠር እና የክልሉን ታሪክ ለማዛባት ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Duulaan beekamaan Faransaayi Eliyaas d'Imzalene jecha 'intifadaa' jedhu fayyadamuu isaa hordofee hidhaa fi adabbii faayinaansii mudateera; qaamoleen mootummaa jechicha akka waamicha jeequmsaatti hiikaniiru. Kunis gareewwan Israa'el deggeran yaada mormii akka jibbaatti ilaaluuf jechoota fayyadamuu akka meeshaatti itti fayyadamaa jiran mul'isa. Yaaliin akkanaa, kanneen akka Muuziyeemni Biritish maqaa Palastiin akka kaasu dirqisiisuu, yaada ummataa to'achuu fi seenaa naannichaa dhoksuuf kan kaayyeeffatedha.

title: UEFA Super Cup – PSG vs Aston Villa: Prediction, start time, how to watch
english: The UEFA Super Cup will feature a match between Champions League winners Paris Saint-Germain and Europa League champions Aston Villa. The game is scheduled for Wednesday, August 12, at 19:00 GMT and will be held at the Red Bull Arena in Salzburg, Austria. PSG enters the contest as the betting favorite to win this prestigious season-opening trophy.
amharic: የዩኤፍኤ (UEFA) ሱፐር ካፕ የቻምፒዮንስ ሊግ አሸናፊውን ፓሪሰን ዠርሜይን እና የዩሮፓ ሊግ አሸናፊውን አስቶን ቪላ የሚያገናኝ ጨዋታ ይሆናል። ይህ ጨዋታ ነሐሴ 12 ቀን ከቀኑ 19:00 በኦስትሪያ ሳልዝበርግ በሚገኘው ሬድ ቡል አሬና ይካሄዳል። ፓሪሰን ዠርሜይን የውድድሩን መክፈቻ ዋንጫ ለማንሳት ቀዳሚ ግምት የተሰጠው ቡድን ነው።
oromo: Qophiin UEFA Super Cup tapha gidduu injifattoota Champions League kan ta'e Paris Saint-Germain fi injifattoota Europa League kan ta'e Aston Villa gidduutti godhamuudha. Taphi kun guyyaa Roobii Hagayya 12, sa'aatii 19:00 irratti istaadiyoomii Red Bull Arena kan Awustiriyaa keessatti kan taphatamuudha. PSG tapha kana moo'achuuf carraa guddaa qabaatanii seenu.

title: Protesters rally in India’s Jharkhand over alleged exam irregularities
english: Students in India's Jharkhand state are staging protests to demand reforms in the government recruitment process following allegations of exam paper leaks. Although the government has canceled some examinations and some officials have resigned, protesters are continuing their demonstrations to demand a federal investigation and the cancellation of additional tests. The situation has intensified with police using water cannons to disperse crowds and several student leaders participating in a long-term hunger strike.
amharic: በህንድ ጃርካንድ ግዛት የሚገኙ ተማሪዎች በመንግስት ፈተናዎች ላይ የተፈጸመ ነው የተባለውን የጥያቄ ወረቀት መፍሰስ በመቃወም ተቃውሞ እያደረጉ ነው። መንግስት አንዳንድ ፈተናዎችን ቢሰርዝም እና አንዳንድ የቦርድ አባላት ከስልጣናቸው ቢለቁም፣ ተቃዋሚዎቹ ግን የፌደራል ምርመራ እንዲደረግና ተጨማሪ ፈተናዎች እንዲሰረዙ በመጠየቅ ላይ ናቸው። ሁኔታው ተባብሶ በመቀጠሉ ፖሊስ የውሃ መድፍ ተጠቅሞ ተቃዋሚዎችን ለመበተን የተገደደ ሲሆን፣ የተማሪ መሪዎችም የረሃብ አድማ በመምታት ተቃውሟቸውን ቀጥለዋል።
oromo: Barattoonni naannoo Jharkhand kan Hindii, qormaata mootummaa keessatti himatamee jiru yakkaafi hanqina gadi fageenyaan qorachuu gaafachuun hiriira mormii geggeessaa jiru. Mootummaan qormaata tokko tokko haquu fi miseensonni boordii tokko tokko gadhiisuun isaa kan beekame ta'us, barattoonni garuu qorannoon federaalaan akka geggeeffamuu fi qormaanni biroo akka haqamu gaafachaa jiru. Hiriirichi hammaachaa adeemnaan poolisiin bishaan humnaan gadi lakkisuun hiriirtota bittinneessaa jiraachuu fi hoogganoonni barattootaa immoo duula beelaa geggeessuun mormii isaanii itti fufanii jiru.

title: Remembering Anas, Mohammed and Gaza’s other slain journalists
english: On the first anniversary of their deaths, the media community is honoring Al Jazeera journalists Anas al-Sharif, Mohammed Qreiqeh, and their colleagues who were killed in an Israeli airstrike in Gaza last year. These reporters are being remembered for their incredible bravery and dedication to reporting under extreme conditions. Their work has redefined modern journalism by showing an extraordinary level of commitment to exposing the truth during a humanitarian crisis.
amharic: ለአልጀዚራ ጋዜጠኞች አናስ አል-ሸሪፍ፣ መሀመድ ቁሬቅህ እና በጋዛ እስራኤል ባደረሰችው የአየር ድብደባ ለተገደሉ ሌሎች ባልደረቦቻቸው መታሰቢያ በአንድ ዓመት ሞታቸው እየተካሄደ ነው። እነዚህ ጋዜጠኞች በአስቸጋሪ ሁኔታ ውስጥ ሆነው ያሳዩት ጀግንነት እና ለሙያው ያላቸውን ቁርጠኝነት ዓለም እያወደሰ ይገኛል። የእነርሱም ስራ በሰብአዊ ቀውስ ወቅት እውነትን ለዓለም ለማድረስ ባሳዩት ያልተለመደ ጥረት የጋዜጠኝነትን ሙያ አዲስ ገጽታ እንዲላበስ አድርጓል።
oromo: Guyyaa yaadannoo waggaa tokkoffaa du'a gaazexeessota Al Jazeera Anas Al-Sharif, Mohammed Qreiqeh fi hiriyoota isaanii kan bara darbe Gaza keessatti xiyyaaraan ajjeefamanii dha. Gaazexeessotni kunneen haala baay'ee ulfaataa ta'e keessatti iyyuu ija jabinaan oduu gabaasaa turuun isaanii yaadatamuu qaba. Hojii isaaniitiin rakkoo namoomaa jiru ifa baasuuf carraaqqii guddaa godhaniiru, kunis hojii gaazexeessummaa bara amanaa keessatti iddoo guddaa kan qabu fi fakkeenya gaarii kan ta'e dha.

title: What’s behind Trump’s shift to economic pressure on Iran? Will it work?
english: President Trump has shifted his strategy in the ongoing conflict with Iran, moving away from direct military strikes in favor of intense economic pressure. The U.S. is currently utilizing a naval blockade to disrupt Iranian ports, aiming to capitalize on the country's existing financial struggles and high inflation. While officials suggest this approach is part of a broader diplomatic and economic strategy, negotiations regarding the blocked Strait of Hormuz remain uncertain.
amharic: ፕሬዚዳንት ትራምፕ ከኢራን ጋር ባለው ግጭት የነበራቸውን ወታደራዊ እርምጃ በመተው ወደ ጠንካራ የኢኮኖሚ ማዕቀብ ማዘዋወራቸውን አስታውቀዋል። አሜሪካ የኢራን ወደቦችን በባህር ኃይል በመዝጋት በሀገሪቱ የዋጋ ግሽበት እና የኢኮኖሚ ቀውስ ላይ ጫና ለመፍጠር እየሞከረች ነው። ይህ ስልት ዲፕሎማሲያዊ እና ኢኮኖሚያዊ አካሄዶችን ያካተተ ቢሆንም፣ በሆርሙዝ ባህረ ሰላጤ መተላለፊያ ላይ እየተደረጉ ያሉ ንግግሮች እስካሁን ግልጽ የሆነ ውጤት አላመጡም።
oromo: Pireezidaant Traamp gartuun isaanii walitti bu'iinsa Iraan waliin jiru keessatti tarkaanfii waraanaa irraa gara dhiibbaa diinagdee cimaatti ce'uu isaanii ibsaniiru. Yeroo ammaa mootummaan Ameerikaa buufataalee Iraan to'achuudhaan dhiibbaa dinagdee fi gatii dabaluu irratti hundaa'ee biyyattii laaffisuuf tattaaffachaa jira. Tarkaanfiin kun tarsiimoo diiplomaasii fi diinagdee bal'aa ta'e keessaa tokko yoo ta'us, dhimmi karaa bishanii Hormuz irratti mariin taasifamu ammayyuu xumura hin arganne.

title: Powerful Typhoon Dolphin hits China, prompting flood and landslide warnings
english: Typhoon Dolphin recently hit China’s eastern coast, bringing destructive winds and intense rainfall that forced the evacuation of hundreds of thousands of residents. The storm caused significant travel disruptions, including the cancellation of over 1,300 flights in Shanghai, and triggered severe flood and landslide warnings. Before reaching China, the typhoon also caused deadly landslides and flooding in the northern Philippines.
amharic: ዶልፊን የተሰኘው ኃይለኛ አውሎ ንፋስ በቻይና ምስራቃዊ የባህር ዳርቻ በመድረሱ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት አድርሷል። አውሎ ንፋሱ ያስከተለው የዝናብ እና የንፋስ መጠን መቶ ሺህ የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎችን እንዲፈናቀሉ እንዲሁም በሻንጋይ ከ1,300 በላይ በረራዎች እንዲሰረዙ አድርጓል። በቻይና ላይ ከመድረሱ በፊትም በፊሊፒንስ ሰሜናዊ ክፍል ጎርፍ እና የመሬት መንሸራተት በማስከተል ለሰው ህይወት መጥፋት እና መፈናቀል ምክንያት ሆኗል።
oromo: Bubbee cimaan 'Dolphin' jedhamu qarqara galaana baha Chaayinaa dhaqqabee miidhaa guddaa geessiseera. Bubbeen kun rooba cimaa fi qilleensa humna guddaa qabuun namoota dhibbaan lakkaa'aman akka godaanan dirqisiiseera, akkasumas buufataalee xiyyaaraa Shaanghaay keessatti balaliiwwan 1,300 ol akka haqaman taasiseera. Chaayinaa dhaqqabuu isaa dura, bubbeen kun biyya Filippiins keessatti balaa lolaa fi lafti akka sigigitu taasisuun miidhaa lubbuu fi qabeenyaa geessiseera.

title: Former Thai MP allegedly kills official and confesses on YouTube
english: A former Thai politician, Chalong Riewrang, has been arrested for the fatal shooting of a local official named Thongchai Yenprasert. Following the incident, the suspect called a political commentator during a YouTube livestream to confess to the crime. While he claimed the shooting was accidental and followed a personal dispute, he is now in police custody facing legal consequences.
amharic: የታይላንድ የቀድሞ የፓርላማ አባል የሆኑት ቻሎንግ ሪውራንግ፣ ቶንግቻይ የንፕራሰርት የተባሉ የሀገር ውስጥ ባለስልጣንን በጥይት ገድለዋል በሚል በቁጥጥር ስር ውለዋል። ተጠርጣሪው ወንጀሉን ከፈጸሙ በኋላ በዩቲዩብ የቀጥታ ስርጭት ላይ ለነበረ የፖለቲካ ተንታኝ በመደወል ድርጊቱን በራሳቸው አምነዋል። ተጠርጣሪው ግድያው በአጋጣሚ የተከሰተ እና በግል አለመግባባት የተፈጠረ እንደሆነ ቢናገሩም፣ በአሁኑ ወቅት በፖሊስ ቁጥጥር ስር ሆነው ምርመራ እየተደረገባቸው ይገኛል።
oromo: Miseensi duraanii mana maree Tayilaand Chalong Riewrang jedhaman, aabba aadaa naannichaa Thongchai Yenprasert jedhaman rasaasaan ajjeesaniiru jedhamanii shakkamuun qabamaniiru. Shakkaan kun erga gochicha raawwatanii booda, yeroo qophiin yutuuubii irraa daawwatamaa turetti nama siyaasaa tokkoof bilbilanii gochicha raawwachuu isaanii himaniiru. Ajjeechaan kun kan raawwatame wal-dhabdee dhuunfaa booda akka ta'e fi yaada qofa akka hin turre ibsaniiru; amma garuu poolisiin to'annoo jala oolchanii qorannoo geggeessaa jiru.

title: 'Body in suitcase' found in Australia turns out to be lifelike doll
english: Australian police recently launched a murder investigation after two men discovered a suitcase containing what appeared to be human remains near Sydney. However, forensic analysis later revealed that the contents were actually a highly realistic doll dressed in clothing. Authorities have since closed the case, noting that the doll was so lifelike it was easy to mistake for a person.
amharic: የአውስትራሊያ ፖሊስ በሲድኒ አቅራቢያ በሻንጣ ውስጥ የሰው አስከሬን ተገኝቷል በሚል ምርመራ ጀምሮ ነበር። ነገር ግን የፎረንሲክ ምርመራ ውጤት በሻንጣው ውስጥ የነበረው እውነተኛ የሰው አካል ሳይሆን በጣም እውነተኛ የሚመስል አሻንጉሊት መሆኑን አረጋግጧል። አሻንጉሊቱ የሰው መሰል ቅርፅና ገጽታ ስለነበረው ፖሊስ ለጊዜው ግራ ተጋብቶ ነበር፣ በአሁኑ ወቅት ግን ጉዳዩ ተዘግቷል።
oromo: Poolisiin Awustraaliyaa namoota lamaan reeffa fakkatu tokko waan argataniif qorannoo ajjeechaa jalqabanii turan. Haa ta'u malee, qorannoon saayinsawaa akka agarsiisutti, wantichi reeffa dhugaa utuu hin taane daa'ima (doll) dhugaa fakkaatu ture. Wantichi kan namaa fakkaachuu isaan, poolisiin jalqaba irratti dogoggora keessa kan gale ta'us, amma garuu qorannoon kun xumurameera.

title: June and July hottest on record in Western Europe, monitor says
english: Western Europe has reached record-breaking temperatures throughout June and July, surpassing previous heat levels from 2022. This extreme weather has caused severe droughts and dangerously low river levels, leading to significant wildfires and disruptions in power production. Climate experts note that the drying soil further intensifies the heat, highlighting how climate change is creating a dangerous cycle of environmental stress.
amharic: በምዕራብ አውሮፓ የዘንድሮው የሰኔ እና የሐምሌ ወራት በታሪክ ታይቶ በማይታወቅ ከፍተኛ ሙቀት ተመዝግበዋል። ይህ ከፍተኛ ሙቀት በክልሉ ከባድ ድርቅን እና የወንዞች ውሃ መጠን እንዲቀንስ በማድረጉ፣ የእሳት አደጋዎችን እና የሃይል አቅርቦት መስተጓጎሎችን አስከትሏል። የአየር ንብረት ተመራማሪዎች እንደሚሉት፣ የአፈር መድረቅ ሙቀቱን በበለጠ ስለሚያባብሰው፣ የአየር ንብረት ለውጥ በአካባቢው ላይ ከፍተኛ ተጽዕኖ እያሳደረ ይገኛል።
oromo: Awurooppaa Dhihaa keessatti ji'oota Waxabajjii fi Adoolessa keessa ho'i qaamaa seenaa keessatti mul'atee hin beekne galmaa'ee jira. Ho'i kun gogiinsa cimaa fi hir'ina bishaan laggeenii waan uumeef, ibidda bosonaa babal'ataa fi rakkoo dhiyeessii anniisaa geesiseera. Ogeeyyiin jijjiirama qilleensaa akka ibsanitti, lafti goguun isaa ho'a kana daran waan hammaachiisuuf, jijjiiramni qilleensaa miidhaa naannoo irratti ga'u daran dabalaa jira.

title: UEFA, AFC, CONCACAF hit out at Infantino over World Cup privatisation plan
english: Major football confederations including UEFA, AFC, and CONCACAF have issued a joint letter criticizing FIFA President Gianni Infantino for his controversial plan to sell stakes in the World Cup. These organizations argued that leadership should focus on serving the sport rather than seeking individual control, and they are now demanding an independent investigation into the failed proposal. The move follows growing calls for accountability and leadership changes within the global governing body.
amharic: እንደ UEFA፣ AFC እና CONCACAF ያሉ ዋና ዋና የእግር ኳስ ማህበራት የፊፋ ፕሬዝዳንት ጃኒ ኢንፋንቲኖ የዓለም ዋንጫን ድርሻ በግል ባለሀብቶች ለመሸጥ ያቀረቡትን አወዛጋቢ ዕቅድ በመቃወም በጋራ ደብዳቤ አውጥተዋል። እነዚህ ተቋማት አመራር የግል ስልጣንን መፈለግ ሳይሆን ስፖርቱን ማገልገል እንዳለበት በመግለጽ፣ ያልተሳካው ሀሳብ ላይ ገለልተኛ ምርመራ እንዲደረግ ጠይቀዋል። ይህ እርምጃ በፊፋ ውስጥ የተጠያቂነት እና የአመራር ለውጥ እንዲኖር ግፊት እየጨመረ በመምጣቱ የተወሰደ ነው።
oromo: Gamtaaleen kubbaa miilaa gurguddoon akka UEFA, AFC fi CONCACAF, Pirezidaantiin FIFA Jaanii Infantinoo carraa qooda Waancaa Addunyaa gurguruuf karoorfatan mormuun ibsa tokko baasaniiru. Gamtaaleen kun hogganuummaan fedhii dhuunfaa osoo hin taane, ispoorticha tajaajiluu akka qabu ibsuun, dhimma karoora kufe kana irratti qorannoon walaba ta'e akka gaggeeffamu gaafataniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun FIFA keessatti gaafatamummaa fi jijjiirama hogganuummaa barbaaduun walqabatee kan dhufe dha.

title: One year on, Gaza mourns journalist Anas al-Sharif’s death
english: One year after his death, Palestinians and advocates are honoring Al Jazeera journalist Anas al-Sharif, who was killed in an Israeli airstrike. Al-Sharif was a dedicated reporter from Jabalya who became a vital voice for civilians throughout the conflict in Gaza. His death, along with those of three other media colleagues, is remembered as part of a significant pattern of violence against journalists in the region.
amharic: የአልጀዚራ ጋዜጠኛ አናስ አል-ሻሪፍ በአየር ጥቃት ከተገደሉ አንድ ዓመት በመሆኑ፣ ፍልስጤማውያንና የፕሬስ ነፃነት ተሟጋቾች እሱን እያስታወሱ ነው። በጀባልያ የስደተኞች ካምፕ ተወልዶ ያደገው ጋዜጠኛው፣ በጋዛ የነበረውን የጦርነት ተፅዕኖ ለአለም በማድረስ ረገድ ትልቅ ሚና ነበረው። የእሱና የሌሎች የሥራ ባልደረቦቹ ሞት በጋዛ በጋዜጠኞች ላይ እየተፈጸመ ያለውን የጥቃት አዝማሚያ እንደሚያሳይ ተገልጿል።
oromo: Gaazexeessaan Al Jazeera Anas al-Sharif erga xiyyaaraan rukutamee du'ee waggaa tokko guutee jira, kunis lammiilee Falasxiin fi qindeessitoota mirga gaazexeessitootaan yaadatamuu isaati. Anas ganda baqattootaa Jabalya keessatti dhalatee, waraana Gaaza keessatti miidhaa namoota nagaa irra ga'u gabaasuun sagalee guddaa ta'ee ture. Duuti isaa fi hojjettoota miidiyaa biroo sadii, miidhaa gaazexeessitoota naannichaa irratti raawwatamaa jiru keessaa kutaa tokko akka ta'e dubbatama.

title: Who is Mohsen Rezaei, and how significant is his appointment?
english: Mohsen Rezaei, a former commander of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps, has been appointed as the new secretary of Iran’s Supreme National Security Council. This role puts him in charge of managing national security and foreign policy during a period of intense conflict involving the Strait of Hormuz. Known for his hardline stance on protecting this vital oil route, his appointment signals a focus on strengthening Iran’s leverage against the US and Israel.
amharic: የኢራን እስላማዊ አብዮታዊ ዘብ የቀድሞ አዛዥ ሞህሰን ረዛኢ የኢራን ከፍተኛ የብሔራዊ ደህንነት ምክር ቤት ኃላፊ ሆነው ተሾመዋል። ይህ ሹመት በተለይ የሆርሙዝ የባህር በርን በሚመለከት እየተካሄደ ባለው ውጥረት ውስጥ፣ ሀገሪቱ ለደህንነት እና ለውጭ ግንኙነት ጉዳዮች ትልቅ ትኩረት እንደምትሰጥ ያሳያል። ረዛኢ ስልጣን በያዙበት ወቅት በአሜሪካ እና በእስራኤል ላይ የበለጠ ጫና ለመፍጠር እንደሚንቀሳቀሱ ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Ajajaan duraanii waraana 'IRGC' kan ta'an Mohsen Reza'ii, gorsaa olaanaa nageenya biyyaalessaa kan Iraan ta'uun muudamaniiru. Muudamni kun yeroo humnoonni Iraan fi biyyoonni dhihaa dhimma daandii galaana Hormuz irratti wal-dhabdee keessa jiranitti kan dhufe dha. Reza'iin dhimma nageenyaa fi siyaasa alaarratti gahee guddaa kan qabaatan ta'uun, muudamni isaanii immoo mootummaan Iraan dhiibbaa Ameerikaa fi Israa'el irratti qabu cimsuu akka barbaadu kan agarsiisu dha.

title: Tropical Storm Dolphin batters eastern China with heavy rain, strong winds
english: Tropical Storm Dolphin recently struck eastern China, forcing the evacuation of over a million people due to severe flooding and high-speed winds. The storm initially made landfall as a powerful typhoon, causing significant flight cancellations and disruption across multiple provinces. As the system moves inland, authorities continue to warn of potential landslides and heavy rainfall, extending flood alerts to the capital, Beijing.
amharic: የዶልፊን ሞቃታማ አውሎ ንፋስ በቅርቡ በምስራቅ ቻይና በመከሰቱ ከባድ ጎርፍ እና ንፋስ በመፍጠሩ ከአንድ ሚሊዮን በላይ ሰዎች ከቤታቸው እንዲለቁ ተደርጓል። አውሎ ንፋሱ መጀመሪያ በኃይለኛ የቲፎኖ መልክ በመምጣቱ በበርካታ ግዛቶች ውስጥ የአውሮፕላን በረራዎች እንዲሰረዙ እና ከፍተኛ መስተጓጎል እንዲፈጠር አድርጓል። አውሎ ንፋሱ ወደ ውስጥኛው የሀገሪቱ ክፍል እየተጓዘ በመሆኑ፣ ባለስልጣናት የመሬት መንሸራተት እና የጎርፍ አደጋ ስጋት ስላለ ጥንቃቄ እንዲደረግ አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Bubbeen Dolphin jedhamu kan kaaba-baha Chaayinaa keessatti mudate, rooba cimaa fi qilleensa humna guddaa qabuun waan hordofsiiseef namoonni miiliyoona tokko ol ta'an iddoo jireenya isaanii gadhiisanii akka baqatan dirqisiiseera. Bubbeen kun jalqaba yeroo lafa gahuufiifiin cimaa (typhoon) waan tureef, balalii xiyyaaraa hedduu fi qophiiwwan adda addaa irratti rakkoo guddaa uumeera. Bubbeen kun gara giddugaleessa biyyattiitti imalaa waan jiruuf, aanga'oonni bosonaa fi rooba cimaan balaa lolaa waan fiduuf namoonni akka of eeggannoo godhan akeekkachiisaniiru.

title: Syria reclaims control of key coastal sites in deal with Russia
english: Syria and Russia have finalized a deal to reorganize Russia's military presence along the Syrian coast, concluding 18 months of negotiations. Under this agreement, Syria will take over the management of civilian infrastructure at the Hmeimim airbase and the Tartus port, while the military sections will transition into joint training facilities. This shift marks a significant change in the bilateral relationship since the ousting of Bashar al-Assad in 2024, with the transition expected to be finished within three months.
amharic: ሶሪያ እና ሩሲያ በሶሪያ የባህር ዳርቻ ላይ የሩሲያን ወታደራዊ መገኘት ለመቀነስ የሚያስችል ስምምነት ተፈራርመዋል። በስምምነቱ መሰረት ሶሪያ የህሚሚም አየር ማረፊያ እና የጠርቱስ ወደብ ሲቪል መገልገያዎችን በራሷ አስተዳደር ስር የምታደርግ ሲሆን ወታደራዊ ክፍሎቹም ወደ የጋራ ስልጠና ማዕከላት ይቀየራሉ። ይህ ለውጥ ከ2014 እ.ኤ.አ ጀምሮ በሁለቱ ሀገራት ግንኙነት ላይ የታየ ትልቅ ለውጥ ሲሆን የሽግግር ሂደቱም በሚቀጥሉት ሶስት ወራት ውስጥ ይጠናቀቃል ተብሎ ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Sooriyaafi Raashiyaan qarqara galaana Sooriyaa irratti argamu irratti buufata waraanaa Raashiyaa hir'isuuf waliigaltee irra ga'aniiru. Waliigaltee kanaan, Sooriyaan buufata xiyyaaraa Hmeimim fi buufata doonii Tartus keessatti bakkeewwan siivilii to'annoo ishee jala kan galchitu yoo ta'u, kutaan waraanaas gara giddugala leenjii waloo kan jijjiiramu ta'a. Jijjiiramni kun bara 2014 keessa mootummaan Bashar al-Assad erga kufee as hariiroo biyyoota lamaanii keessatti tarkaanfii guddaa kan agarsiisu yoo ta'u, adeemsi kunis ji'oota sadii keessatti xumurama jedhamee eegama.

title: UK couple detained in Iran ends hunger strike
english: A British couple, Lindsay and Craig Foreman, have stopped their long-term hunger strikes in an Iranian prison where they are serving time for alleged espionage. The pair, who were arrested during a motorcycle trip in early 2025, have been protesting against harsh prison conditions and the physical impact of their detention. Although they ended their protest after several months, the couple continues to deny all spying accusations brought against them.
amharic: በኢራን እስር ቤት በስለላ ወንጀል የተከሰሱት እንግሊዛውያን ባለትዳሮች ሊንዚ እና ክሬግ ፎርማን ለረጅም ወራት ሲያካሂዱት የነበረውን የረሃብ አድማ አቁመዋል። ጥንዶቹ እ.ኤ.አ በ2025 በሞተር ሳይክል ጉዞ ላይ እያሉ ነበር የታሰሩት፤ እስር ቤቱ ያለው አስከፊ ሁኔታ እና በጤናቸው ላይ እያደረሰ ያለውን ጉዳት በመቃወም ነበር አድማውን የጀመሩት። ጥንዶቹ በእነሱ ላይ የቀረበውን የስለላ ክስ አሁንም በጽኑ ይክዳሉ።
oromo: Jarreen biyya Ingiliz kan ta'an Lindsay fi Craig Foreman, mana hidhaa Iraan keessatti himannaa basaasummaan hidhamanii turan, waggaa kana keessa erga beela qabanii booda amma dhaabaniiru. Qaamonni kunneen bara 2025 imala mootar saayikilii irratti utuu jiranii kan qabaman yoo ta'u, haala sukaneessa mana hidhichaa fi miidhaa qaamaa irra gahu mormuun waggaa guutuu soomii turan. Himannaa basaasummaa irratti dhiyaateefis guutummaatti kan haalan yoo ta'u, ammaaf akkaataa haala isaa hordofaa jiru.

title: Israeli strike causes 'major explosion' in south Lebanon, state media reports
english: Israeli forces conducted a series of military actions in southern Lebanon on Monday, including a significant explosion in Zaoutar el-Charkiya. The strikes also targeted villages such as Mansouri and Bani Hayyan using artillery fire. Additionally, Israeli military units reportedly fired machine guns toward the Wadi Slouki area during the early morning hours.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደሮች ሰኞ ዕለት በደቡብ ሊባኖስ በተለያዩ አካባቢዎች ወታደራዊ ጥቃቶችን አድርሰዋል። በዚህም መሰረት በዛውታር ኤል-ሻርኪያ ግዙፍ ፍንዳታ የተከሰተ ሲሆን፣ ማንሱሪ እና ባኒ ሃያን የተባሉ መንደሮችም በከባድ መሳሪያ ተመትተዋል። በተጨማሪም በእለቱ ጎህ ሲቀድ በዋዲ ስሉኪ አካባቢ በመትረየስ ተኩስ እንደተከፈተ ተዘግቧል።
oromo: Humnootiin Israa'eel Dilbata ganama kibba Libaanositti duula waraanaa gaggeessaniin, magaalaa Za’uutaar el-Shaarkiyaa keessatti dhohiinsa guddaan tokko mudateera. Haleellaa kanaan ganda Maansurii fi Baanii Haayaan irratti waraanni miilaa (artillery) kan itti darbatame yoo ta’u, naannoo Waadii Sluukii keessattis ganama bariitiin rasaasni meeshaa gurguddaa dhukaafameera.

title: US says it has rerouted 55 Iran-linked vessels
english: The U.S. military has announced that it successfully redirected 55 commercial ships that were heading toward Iran. This action is part of an ongoing effort by U.S. forces in the Middle East to enforce strict maritime trade restrictions on the country. Additionally, authorities have disabled two vessels and carried out inspections on others to confirm they are following these regulations.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ ኃይል ወደ ኢራን በመጓዝ ላይ የነበሩ 55 የንግድ መርከቦችን አቅጣጫ ማስቀየሩን አስታውቋል። ይህ እርምጃ በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ የሚገኙ የአሜሪካ ኃይሎች በኢራን ላይ የጣሉትን የንግድ ገደቦች ለማስፈጸም የሚያደርጉት ጥረት አካል ነው። በተጨማሪም ባለስልጣናቱ ሁለት መርከቦችን ለአገልግሎት እንዳይውሉ ማድረጋቸውን እና ሌሎች መርከቦችም ህጉን እያከበሩ መሆኑን ለማረጋገጥ ፍተሻ ማድረጋቸውን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Humnoonni waraana Ameerikaa dooniiwwan daldalaa 55 gara Iraan imalaa turan karaa irraa akka jalqaban beeksisaniiru. Tarkaanfiin kun qondaalonni Ameerikaa naannoo Baha Giddu-galeessaa keessatti daldala Iraan irratti daangaa kaa'ame akka kabajamu gochuuf kan fudhatame dha. Kana malees, waraanni Ameerikaa dooniiwwan lama akka dhaabatan godhee, kanneen biroos seera kabajuu isaanii mirkaneeffachuuf qorannoo geggeessaa jira.

title: Iran says it is not concerned by new 'Mecca Joint Defence Agreement'
english: The Iranian government has stated that it does not view the new security agreement between Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan as a threat. Officials in Tehran suggest this pact reflects a regional move toward self-reliance and away from dependence on Western powers. Iran welcomed the initiative, provided it remains focused on regional stability and countering shared adversaries.
amharic: የኢራን መንግሥት በሳውዲ አረቢያ፣ በቱርክ እና በፓኪስታን መካከል የተፈረመው አዲስ የጸጥታ ስምምነት በእነሱ ላይ ስጋት እንደማይፈጥር ገልጿል። የቴህራን ባለስልጣናት ይህ ስምምነት የክልሉ ሀገራት በውጭ ኃይሎች ላይ ከመመካት ይልቅ በራሳቸው አቅም ላይ ለመታመን እያደረጉት ያለውን ለውጥ እንደሚያሳይ ተናግረዋል። ኢራን ስምምነቱ የክልሉን ሰላም ለማስጠበቅ እና የጋራ ጠላቶችን ለመከላከል የሚያግዝ ከሆነ አዎንታዊ እንደሆነ አስታውቃለች።
oromo: Mootummaan Iraan waliigaltee nageenyaa haaraa Sa’udii Arabiyaa, Turkii fi Paakistaan gidduutti mallatteeffame irratti yaaddoo akka hin qabne ibseera. Hoji-raawwattoonni Teheran akka jedhanitti, waliigaltichi biyyoonni naannichaa humnoota alaa irratti hirkachuu mannaa dandeettii ofii isaanii irratti akka hundaa’an agarsiisa. Iraan waliigaltichi tasgabbii naannichaa kabachiisuufi diina waliinii ittisuuf kan gargaaru erga ta’ee, akka deegartu ibsiteetti.

title: At least 13 killed in Ukrainian drone strike on Russia's Tatarstan region, officials say
english: A Ukrainian drone attack on the Russian region of Tatarstan has resulted in at least 13 deaths, including a child, and dozens of injuries. The strike targeted industrial sites and residential areas located over 1,000 kilometers from the Ukrainian border. This incident marks one of the most severe attacks inside Russian territory since the conflict began, leading to a declared period of mourning in the region.
amharic: ዩክሬን በሩሲያ ታታርስታን ክልል ባደረሰችው የድሮን ጥቃት ቢያንስ 13 ሰዎች መሞታቸው የተገለጸ ሲሆን፣ ከተጎጂዎች መካከል ህፃናት እንደሚገኙበት ተመላክቷል። ከዩክሬን ድንበር ከ1,100 ኪሎሜትር በላይ ርቀት ላይ በሚገኘው የኒዝኔካምስክ ከተማ ላይ የተፈጸመው ይህ ጥቃት የኢንዱስትሪ ተቋማትን እና የመኖሪያ አካባቢዎችን ያነጣጠረ ነው። በሩሲያ እና በዩክሬን መካከል ጦርነቱ ከተጀመረ ወዲህ ከታዩ አስከፊ ጥቃቶች አንዱ ተደርጎ በሚወሰደው በዚህ ድርጊት ምክንያት በክልሉ የሀዘን ቀናት ታውጇል።
oromo: Humni Yukreen naannoo Taataaristaan kan Raashiyaa keessatti weerara doonii (drone) geggeesseen lubbuun namoota 13 ol darbeera; kanneen du'an keessas daa'imni tokko akka jiru himameera. Haleellaan kun bakkeewwan industirii fi qubata namootaa kan magaalaan isaa daangaa Yukreen irraa fageenya kiilomeetira 1,100 caalu irratti argamtu irratti xiyyeeffateera. Haleellaan kun walitti bu'iinsi biyyoota lamaanii erga jalqabee ergaa hamaa fi kan namoota hedduu miidhe waan ta'eef, naannichatti guyyaan gaddaa labsameera.

title: China evacuates one million from homes as massive storm arrives
english: Chinese authorities have evacuated over a million residents as Typhoon Dolphin, the strongest storm of the year, struck the eastern coast. The severe weather caused widespread transportation disruptions, including the cancellation of nearly 1,000 flights in Shanghai. While the typhoon has been downgraded to a tropical storm, officials warn that heavy rains and flooding could persist for several days.
amharic: የቻይና ባለስልጣናት የዘንድሮው እጅግ ጠንካራ የሆነው የዶልፊን አውሎ ንፋስ ምስራቃዊ የባህር ዳርቻን በመምታቱ ከሚሊዮን በላይ የሚሆኑ ነዋሪዎችን ለቀዋል፡፡ አውሎ ንፋሱ በሻንጋይ ወደ 1,000 የሚጠጉ በረራዎችን ጨምሮ የመጓጓዣ ስራዎችን አስተጓጉሏል። ምንም እንኳን አውሎ ንፋሱ መጠኑ ቢቀንስም፣ ባለስልጣናት በጠንካራ ዝናብ እና በጎርፍ አደጋ ምክንያት ጥንቃቄ እንዲደረግ አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Chaayinaa obomboleettiin 'Dolphin' jedhamu kan bara kanaa hunda caalu magaalota gama bahaa rukutuusaa hordofee namoota miiliyoona tokko ol ta'an iddoo jireenyaa isaanii irraa godaansiseera. Obomboleettiin kun magaalota gurguddoo dabalatee tajaajila geejjibaa fi balaliin xiyyaaraa 1,000 ol akka dhaabbatu godheera. Obomboleettiin sun gara obomboleetii laafaa ta'etti kan hir'ate ta'us, roobii fi lolaan cimaan guyyoota dhufanitti itti fufuu waan danda'uuf ummanni of eeggannoo akka godhu gorfameera.

title: China evacuates a million from homes as Typhoon Dolphin arrives
english: Typhoon Dolphin has hit eastern China, including the city of Shanghai, with powerful winds reaching 150 km/h. Authorities have relocated over one million people to ensure their safety as the storm causes severe flooding and transit disruptions. The region remains on high alert due to ongoing heavy rainfall and the potential for dangerous landslides.
amharic: ዶልፊን የተባለው አውሎ ነፋስ በሻንጋይ ከተማን ጨምሮ በምስራቅ ቻይና በመድረሱ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት እያደረሰ ይገኛል። ነፋሱ በሰዓት እስከ 150 ኪሎ ሜትር ፍጥነት ያለው በመሆኑ ከአንድ ሚሊዮን በላይ ሰዎች እንዲለቁ ተደርጓል። አውሎ ነፋሱ ከባድ ዝናብ፣ ጎርፍ እና የመሬት መንሸራተት አደጋዎችን በማስከተል የትራንስፖርት እንቅስቃሴን አወክቷል።
oromo: Obomboleettiin Dolphin jedhamu sunis naannoo baha Chaayinaa fi magaalaa Shaanghaay miidhaa hamaa geessiseera. Bubbeen kun saffisa kiiloomeetira 150/sa'aatiin waan deemuuf, namoonni miiliyoona tokko ol ta'an akka mana isaanii gadi lakkisan dirqamanii jiru. Obomboleettiin kun rooba cimaa, lolaa fi balaa lafa sigigaachuu geessisuun tajaajila geejjibaa guutumatti dhaabeera.

title: Nigeria eliminated as Cameroon, Malawi reach WAFCON semis and World Cup
english: Malawi made history by defeating Ghana to reach the WAFCON semifinals and qualify for their first-ever FIFA World Cup. Meanwhile, Cameroon caused a major upset by knocking out the defending champions, Nigeria, with a narrow victory. These results mean Malawi, Cameroon, Morocco, and Algeria are the final four teams competing for the title, with all of them securing spots in the 2027 World Cup.
amharic: ማላዊ ጋናን በማሸነፍ በታሪኳ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ ወደ ዋፍኮን ግማሽ ፍጻሜ እና የፊፋ የዓለም ዋንጫ ማለፍ ችላለች። በሌላ በኩል ካሜሮን നിലവിലെ አሸናፊዋን ናይጄሪያን በማሸነፍ ትልቅ ግርምትን ፈጥራለች። እነዚህ ውጤቶች ማላዊ፣ ካሜሮን፣ ሞሮኮ እና አልጄሪያ የግማሽ ፍጻሜ ተፋላሚዎች እንዲሆኑ ያደረጉ ሲሆን አራቱም ቡድኖች ለ2027 የዓለም ዋንጫ ተሳትፎ ማረጋገጫ አግኝተዋል።
oromo: Maalaawiin Gaanaa injifachuun seenaa hojjechaa, yeroo jalqatiif gara semi-fayinaalii WAFCON fi tapha waancaa addunyaa FIFA-tti darbiteetti. Gamtaan biroo, Kaameruun qabxii ajaa'ibsiisaa galchuun garee mo'ataa ture Naayijeeriyaa dorgommichaa ala gooteetti. Bu'aan kun Maalaawii, Kaameruun, Morookoo fi Aljeeriyaan semi-fayinaalii akka ga'an kan taasise yoo ta'u, afuurri isaanii iyyuu waancaa addunyaa bara 2027-f qulqullaa'aniiru.

title: Pakistan-administered Kashmir votes in reduced third phase amid unrest
english: The final phase of elections in Pakistan-administered Kashmir is currently underway, though voting is limited to only four out of the 11 planned constituencies due to ongoing security concerns. The remaining districts saw elections postponed following violent protests led by a local activist group demanding reforms to legislative seat allocations. Authorities have banned the activist group and implemented strict media restrictions while facing significant unrest that has resulted in numerous casualties.
amharic: በፓኪስታን አስተዳደር ስር ባለው ካሽሚር የህግ መወሰኛ ምክር ቤት የመጨረሻ የምርጫ ዙር እየተካሄደ ቢሆንም፣ በፀጥታ ችግሮች ምክንያት ከታቀዱት 11 የምርጫ ክልሎች ውስጥ በአራቱ ብቻ ነው ድምጽ እየተሰጠ ያለው። ቀሪዎቹ የምርጫ ክልሎች ምርጫ የተራዘመው፣ የህግ መወሰኛ ምክር ቤት መቀመጫዎች እንዲሻሻሉ በሚጠይቁ ቡድኖች በተቀሰቀሰው አመጽ ምክንያት ነው። መንግስት እነዚህን ተቃዋሚ ቡድኖች በመከልከል እና የሚዲያ ገደቦችን በመጣል ላይ ሲሆን፣ ግጭቶቹ ለበርካታ ሰዎች ህይወት መጥፋት ምክንያት ሆነዋል።
oromo: Filannoon marsaa dhumaa kan bulchiinsa Paakistaan jala jiru Kaashmiir keessatti gaggeeffamaa kan jiru yoo ta’u, rakkoo nageenyaa mudateen kan ka’e bakkeewwan 11 keessaa aanaalee afur qofatti qofa filannoon kun geggeeffamaa jira. Aanaaleen hafan kanneenis duula mirga argachuu barbaadanii fi mormii cimaa uumameen walqabatee filannoon isaa akka dabru godhameera. Mootummaan garee mormituu kana dhowwuun akkasumas miidiyaaleerratti uggura kaa'uun kan beekamu yoo ta'u, walitti bu'iinsi uumame lubbuu namoota hedduu galaafateera.

title: North Korea’s hackers using AI for attacks, cybersecurity firm says
english: A South Korean cybersecurity firm reports that North Korean hackers, specifically the Kimsuky group, are now utilizing artificial intelligence to enhance their cyberattacks. By using AI to automatically create convincing fake documents, the group can launch large-scale phishing campaigns targeting diplomatic and academic sectors more efficiently. Experts note that this shift marks a new reality where advanced technology is being exploited to bypass traditional security detection.
amharic: የደቡብ ኮሪያ የሳይበር ደህንነት ኩባንያ እንደገለጸው፣ የሰሜን ኮሪያ ጠላፊዎች በተለይም 'ኪምሱኪ' የተባለው ቡድን ጥቃታቸውን ለማጠናከር አርቲፊሻል ኢንተለጀንስ እየተጠቀሙ ነው። ቡድኑ በኤአይ (AI) አማካኝነት አሳማኝ የሆኑ የሐሰት ሰነዶችን በራስ-ሰር በመፍጠር፣ ዲፕሎማቲክ እና አካዳሚክ ተቋማትን ያነጣጠሩ የሳይበር ጥቃቶችን በስፋት እየፈጸመ ይገኛል። ይህ አዲስ የቴክኖሎጂ አጠቃቀም ጠላፊዎች የደህንነት ጥበቃዎችን በቀላሉ ለማለፍ የሚያስችላቸውን አቅም እንደሚሰጣቸው ባለሙያዎች አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Dhaabbanni nageenya saayberii kan biyya Koriyaa Kibbaa akka gabaasetti, hattuun saayberii Koriyaa Kaabaa keessaa kan 'Kimsuky' jedhamu, haleellaa isaanii caalaatti cimsuuf teeknoolojii 'artificial intelligence' itti fayyadamaa jiru. Gareen kun barreeffamoota sobaa amansiisoo ta'an AI fayyadamuun oomishuudhaan, qorattootaa fi jila diippiloomaasii irratti haleellaa bal'aa gaggeessaa jira. Ogeeyyiin akka jedhanitti, teeknoolojiin kun hattuun saayberii akkaataa itti haleellaa raawwatan irratti jijjiirama guddaa fidee jira.

title: The Eritrean Script Exposes Ethiopia’s Unity Farce
english: Ethiopia's current national dialogue process is facing significant criticism for failing to include key political and armed groups, particularly those from the Tigray region. By excluding these major stakeholders and sidelining Tigray from both electoral and parliamentary representation, observers argue the government is repeating historical mistakes that previously led to Eritrea's independence. Experts warn that this lack of genuine, inclusive engagement threatens the country's unity and stability.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ ሀገራዊ የምክክር ኮሚሽን በተለይም የትግራይን ክልል እና ቁልፍ የፖለቲካ ቡድኖችን በማግለሉ ከፍተኛ ትችት እየቀረበበት ነው። መንግስት እነዚህን ወሳኝ አካላት በምክክር ሂደቱና በምርጫው እንዳይሳተፉ ማድረጉ፣ ቀደም ሲል ኤርትራ ከኢትዮጵያ እንድትገነጠል ምክንያት የሆኑ ታሪካዊ ስህተቶችን የሚያስታውስ ነው ተብሏል። ይህ አካታች ያልሆነ ሂደት የሀገሪቱን አንድነትና ሰላም አደጋ ላይ እንደሚጥል ባለሙያዎች ያስጠነቅቃሉ።
oromo: Marii biyyoolessaa Itoophiyaa amma adeemsifamaa jiru kun, keessattuu naannoo Tigraay fi gareewwan siyaasaa guguddoo biroo hirmaachisuu dhabuu isaan qeeqamaa jira. Mootummaan qaamolee murteessoo ta'an kana marii fi filannoo irraa baasuu isaatiin, kanaan dura sababa biyyi Ertiraa Itoophiyaa irraa gargar baatee of danda'uuf sababa ta'e dogoggora seenaa irra deebi'aa jiraachuu akka fakkaatu qeequun himama. Adeemsi kun kan hin hammachiifne fi walitti bu'iinsa kan hin furre ta'uun isaa tokkummaa fi nageenya biyyattii balaaf saaxilaa jiraachuu isaa ogeeyyonni ni ibsu.

title: Don Nelson, Hall of Fame basketball coach and NBA player, dies at 86
english: Legendary NBA figure Don Nelson has passed away at the age of 86. As a player, he secured five championships with the Boston Celtics, and he later became renowned as a creative coach with the second-most career wins in league history. Known for his innovative 'Nellie Ball' strategy, he left a lasting legacy on the sport and mentored stars like Dirk Nowitzki.
amharic: የቅርጫት ኳስ ታላቁ ሰው ዶን ኔልሰን በ86 ዓመታቸው ከዚህ ዓለም በሞት ተለዩ። እንደ ተጫዋችነት አምስት የኤንቢኤ ዋንጫዎችን ያነሱት ኔልሰን፣ በአሰልጣኝነት ዘመናቸው በሊጉ ታሪክ ሁለተኛው ብዙ ድሎችን በማስመዝገብ ይታወቃሉ። በፈጠራ የተሞላው የጨዋታ ስልታቸው በስፖርቱ ላይ ትልቅ አሻራ ጥሎ ያለፈ ሲሆን፣ እንደ ዲርክ ኖዊትዝኪ ላሉ ኮከብ ተጫዋቾች መካሪ ነበሩ።
oromo: Leenjisaa fi taphataa kubbaa kashaa NBA beekamaa kan ta'an Don Nelson umurii waggaa 86tti du'aan boqotaniiru. Taphatummaan waggoota dheeraaf taphachaa erga turanii booda, leenjisaa ta'uun galmee seenaa NBA keessatti injifannoo baay'ee argachuun isaan lammaffaa ta'uun isaanii ni yaadatama. Mala taphaa haaraa 'Nellie Ball' jedhamuun beekamtii kan argatan yoo ta'u, taphattoota gurguddoo akka Dirk Nowitzki jedhamaniif barsiisaa gaarii turaniiru.

title: Israeli forces kill one in Gaza as another body recovered from rubble
english: Israeli military actions in Gaza have resulted in at least two recent deaths, including one person shot in Deir el-Balah and another found under building debris. Several civilians, including children, sustained injuries from tank fire and artillery strikes across various parts of the territory. Meanwhile, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has officially turned down a peace proposal suggested by Donald Trump, insisting that military operations will continue.
amharic: በጋዛ በተካሄደው የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ጥቃት ቢያንስ ሁለት ፍልስጤማውያን ህይወታቸው አልፏል፤ አንደኛው በዴር አል-ባላህ በጥይት ሲገደል ሌላኛው ደግሞ ከህንጻ ፍርስራሽ ስር ተገኝቷል። በተለያዩ የጋዛ አካባቢዎች በተከፈተ የተኩስ እና የከባድ መሳሪያ ድብደባ ህጻናትን ጨምሮ በርካታ ሲቪሎች ቆስለዋል። በሌላ በኩል ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ የዶናልድ ትራምፕን የሰላም እቅድ ውድቅ በማድረግ ወታደራዊ እርምጃው እንደሚቀጥል አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Humni waraana Israa'eel Gazaatti weerara geggeesseen lubbuun namoota lamaa darbeera; tokko naannoo Deir el-Balahitti yoo ajjeefamu, kaan immoo daaraa manaa jalaa argameera. Miidhaan qaamaa fi rukutuun meeshaa waraanaatis naannoolee garaagaraatti daa'imman dabalatee namoota hedduu irra ga'eera. Gama biraatiin, ministirri muummee Benyaamin Netanyaahuu karoorri nagaa Donald Traamp dhiyeessan fudhatama akka hin qabne ibsuun, waraanni itti fufuuf akka jiru mirkaneessaniiru.

title: Solar eclipse tracker: What time will it hit your location on August 12?
english: On August 12, 2026, a total solar eclipse will travel across the Arctic, Greenland, Iceland, and Spain. While about 15 million people are in the path of totality where the sun will be completely blocked, nearly one billion people across parts of Europe, Africa, and the United States will be able to see a partial eclipse. This rare event marks the first total solar eclipse in mainland Europe since 1999.
amharic: እ.ኤ.አ. ነሐሴ 12 ቀን 2026 የሚከሰት አጠቃላይ የፀሐይ ግርዶሽ በአርክቲክ፣ በግሪንላንድ፣ በአይስላንድ እና በስፔን በኩል ያልፋል። ወደ 15 ሚሊዮን የሚጠጉ ሰዎች ፀሐይ ሙሉ በሙሉ የምትሸፈንባቸው አካባቢዎች ውስጥ የሚገኙ ሲሆን፣ ወደ አንድ ቢሊዮን የሚጠጉ ሰዎች ደግሞ በከፊል ግርዶሹን ማየት ይችላሉ። ይህ ብርቅዬ ክስተት ከ1999 ወዲህ በአውሮፓ ዋና መሬት ላይ የሚታይ የመጀመሪያው ሙሉ የፀሐይ ግርዶሽ ይሆናል።
oromo: Guyyaa Hagayya 12, 2026 aduun guutummaatti kan haguugamtu yoo ta'u, kunis Arktik, Gireenlaandi, Aayislaandii fi Ispeen keessatti mul'ata. Namoonni miiliyoona 15 ta'an bakka aduun guutummaatti haguugamtu keessa kan jiran yoo ta'u, namoonni biyyoolessa tokkoo ol ta'an immoo adduun hir'attee mul'achuu ishee ilaaluu danda'u. Kunis biyya Awurooppaa keessatti guyyaa bara 1999 booda yeroo jalqabaaf aduun guutummaatti haguugamtu dha.

title: What’s driving unrest in Pakistan-administered Kashmir?
english: Pakistan-administered Kashmir is currently experiencing its most significant political instability in recent years. Violent demonstrations have erupted in the region as residents head to the final stage of local elections. These ongoing clashes highlight deep-seated tensions within the territory regarding its governance and political future.
amharic: ፓኪስታን የምታስተዳድረው ካሽሚር ባለፉት ጥቂት ዓመታት ውስጥ ከፍተኛ የሆነ የፖለቲካ ቀውስ ውስጥ ትገኛለች። ክልሉ በመጨረሻው የምርጫ ዙር ላይ እያለ ለሞት የሚዳርጉ ተቃውሞዎች እየተካሄዱ ነው። ይህ ሁከት በክልሉ አስተዳደር እና በፖለቲካዊ የወደፊት እጣ ፈንታ ላይ ያለውን ከፍተኛ አለመግባባት ያሳያል።
oromo: Kashmiir kan Paakistaan bulchaa jirtu kun waggoota hedduu keessatti rakkoo siyaasaa hamaa keessa seentee jirti. Naannichi filannoo xumuraa geggeessaa osoo jiruu, hiriirri mormii lubbuu namaa galaafate mudachaa jira. Mormiin kun garaagarummaa bulchiinsa naannichaa fi fuulduree siyaasaa irratti jiru kan mul'isu dha.

title: Israeli general says Gaza should remain ‘destroyed for generations’
english: A retired Israeli general, Giora Eiland, has publicly suggested that Gaza should stay in a ruined state for decades. He argued that preventing the reconstruction of the territory serves Israel’s interests by keeping the population in a state of deep despair. He views the widespread destruction as a permanent reminder of the events that took place on October 7.
amharic: የቀድሞው የእስራኤል የብሔራዊ ደኅንነት ምክር ቤት ኃላፊ ጊዮራ አይላንድ፣ ጋዛ ለበርካታ አስርት ዓመታት ፈራርሳ እንድትቆይ ሐሳብ አቅርበዋል። የጋዛን መፈራረስ መከላከል ለእስራኤል ጥቅም ሲባል አስፈላጊ መሆኑን የገለጹት ጄኔራሉ፣ ይህም በነዋሪዎች ዘንድ ተስፋ መቁረጥን እንደሚፈጥር ተናግረዋል። ይህ ከፍተኛ ውድመት በጥቅምት 7 የተከናወኑትን ክስተቶች ለማስታወስ እንደ ማስረጃ ሆኖ ማገልገል እንዳለበትም ጠቁመዋል።
oromo: Ajajaan waraanaa Israa'el kan ta'an Giyora Ayilaandi, lafti Gaaza waggoota dheeraaf diigamee akka hafu yaada kennaniiru. Gaaza deebi'ee ijaaramuun faayidaa Israa'el akka hin qabne kan ibsan yoo ta'u, kunis uummata achi keessa jiru abdii kutachiisuuf gargaara jedhaniiru. Miidhaa fi diigamni gurguddaan kun yaadannoo guyyaa Onkoloolessa 7 ta'eef akka ta'uufi kunis Israa'eliif faayidaa akka qabu dubbataniiru.

title: Morning update
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has stated that military forces will remain in Gaza until Hamas completely surrenders its weapons, despite previous peace plan proposals. Meanwhile, Lebanon has threatened to boycott upcoming talks with Israel unless their specific conditions are satisfied. Additionally, a Houthi drone strike in the Yemeni city of Mocha resulted in at least seven deaths and thirty injuries.
amharic: የእስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ ሀማስ መሳሪያውን እስካልፈታ ድረስ ወታደራዊ ኃይላቸው በጋዛ እንደሚቆይ አስታውቀዋል። በሌላ በኩል ሊባኖስ ያቀረበችው ቅድመ ሁኔታ ካልተሟላ በስተቀር ከእስራኤል ጋር በሚደረገው ቀጣይ ውይይት እንደማትሳተፍ ገልጻለች። በየመን የሞቻ ወደብ ከተማ በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በተፈጸመ የድሮን ጥቃት ቢያንስ ሰባት ሰዎች ሲሞቱ ሠላሳ የሚሆኑት ደግሞ ቆስለዋል።
oromo: Mummichi ministeeraa Israa'el Benyaamin Netaaniyaahu, dhaabbanni Hamaas meeshaa waraanaa isaa hunda hanga gadi hin dhiisetti waraanni isaanii Gaazaa keessaa akka hin baane ibsaniiru. Gama biraatiin, Libaanoon haala isheen gaafatte yoo hin guutamiin marii Israa'el waliin ta'u irratti hirmaachuu akka dhiistu akeekkachiisteetti. Kana malees, magaalaa Yaman 'Mocha' jedhamtu keessatti haleellaa xiyyaara nama hin feeneen (dronii) garee Huutii qaqqabeen namoonni torba ajjeefamanii soddomni ammoo madaa'aniiru.

title: Union documents 108 Israeli attacks against Palestinian journalists in July
english: The Palestinian Journalists Syndicate reported that Israeli forces carried out 108 violations against media workers during the month of July. These actions included physical assaults, arrests, equipment confiscation, and the raiding of news offices. As a result of these persistent obstacles, journalists are currently unable to safely document and report on events in the region.
amharic: የፍልስጤም ጋዜጠኞች ሲንዲኬት በሐምሌ ወር ብቻ በእስራኤል ኃይሎች በጋዜጠኞች ላይ 108 ጥቃቶች መፈጸማቸውን አስታውቋል። እነዚህ ጥቃቶች ድብደባን፣ እስራትን፣ የሥራ መሣሪያዎችን መውረስን እና የቢሮ ወረራዎችን ያካትታሉ። በእነዚህ ተደጋጋሚ እንቅፋቶች ሳቢያ ጋዜጠኞች በክልሉ የሚፈጸሙትን ክስተቶች በነፃነት መዘገብ ተስኗቸዋል።
oromo: Gamtaan Gaazexeessitoota Palastayinii, ji'a Adooleessaa keessa qofa waraanni Israa'el gaazexeessitoota irratti haleellaa 108 raawwachuu isaa ibseera. Haleellaan kunneen reebicha, hidhaa, meeshaalee hojii fudhachuu fi mana hojii weeraruu kan dabalatudha. Dhiibbaa fi gufuuwwan kun irra deddeebi'anii mudachaa jiraniin, gaazexeessitoonni naannichatti ta'aa jiru gabaasuuf rakkachaa jiru.

title: Wildfires bear down on homes in Canada’s Okanagan region
english: A rapidly spreading wildfire in British Columbia, Canada, is threatening residential areas. Authorities have ordered over 20,000 residents in the Okanagan towns of Summerland and Peachland to evacuate for their safety. Emergency teams are working to manage the situation as the fire approaches homes.
amharic: በካናዳ ብሪቲሽ ኮሎምቢያ ግዛት የተከሰተ አስደንጋጭ የደን ቃጠሎ የመኖሪያ ቤቶችን አደጋ ላይ ጥሏል። የኦካናገን አካባቢ ከተሞች የሆኑት ሰመርላንድ እና ፒችላንድ ነዋሪዎች የሆኑ ከ20,000 በላይ ሰዎች በአስቸኳይ እንዲለቁ ትዕዛዝ ተሰጥቷል። ባለስልጣናት እሳቱ ወደ መኖሪያ ቤቶች እየተጠጋ በመሆኑ የነፍስ አድን ስራዎችን እያከናወኑ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Ibidda bosonaa saffisaan babal'achaa jiru kan Kanadaa, naannoo British Columbia keessatti argamu qe'ee namootaa irratti balaa agarsiisaa jira. Aangotni naannichaa jiraattoota magaalaalee Summerland fi Peachland kan ta'an kuma 20 ol ta'an naannicha gadhiisanii akka baqatan ajajaniiru. Ibidni kun gara manneen jireenyaatti dhiyaachaa waan jiruuf, gareen gargaarsa hatattamaa balaa kana to'achuuf carraaqqii gochaa jiru.

title: Iran, Oman 'very close' to reaching deal, Araghchi says
english: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi announced that Iran and Oman are nearing a final agreement regarding a temporary transit route through the Strait of Hormuz. President Masoud Pezeshkian emphasized that disputes should be handled by a dedicated oversight team rather than through conflict. The leadership suggests a focus on diplomatic cooperation to manage ongoing regional tensions.
amharic: የኢራን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር አባስ አራግቺ፣ ኢራን እና ኦማን በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት በኩል ለጊዜያዊ የመተላለፊያ መንገድ የመጨረሻ ስምምነት ላይ ለመድረስ መቃረባቸውን ገለጹ። የኢራን ፕሬዝዳንት ማስኡድ 페ዜሽኪያንም በበኩላቸው፣ አለመግባባቶች ግጭትን ከመፍጠር ይልቅ በልዩ ኮሚቴ አማካይነት በውይይት መፈታት እንዳለባቸው አሳስበዋል። መሪዎቹ የቀጠናውን ውጥረት ለመቆጣጠር በዲፕሎማሲያዊ ግንኙነት ላይ ትኩረት እንደሚያደርጉ አመላክተዋል።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimmi Alaa Iraan Abbaas Araagchi, Iraan fi Omaan daandii cehuumsaa yeroof fayyadu kan Hormuz irratti walii galtee dhumaa irra gahuuf dhihaachuu isaanii ibsaniiru. Preezidaantiin Iraan Masuud Pezeeshkiyaan gama isaaniin, rakkoolee uumaman wal dhabdee irra gahuu mannaa garee addunyaa irratti hundaa'e kanaan furuun akka filatamu dubbataniiru. Hoggantoonni kunneen dhimmi kun gombisaa fi mariin akka furamu akeekaniiru.

title: US army says 55 commercial vessels redirected amid its blockade against Iran
english: The United States Central Command recently announced that it diverted 55 commercial ships to enforce a blockade against Iran. In addition to these diversions, officials confirmed that two vessels were rendered non-operational, while two others were inspected by military personnel. These actions are part of a broader strategy by U.S. forces to strictly regulate maritime traffic in the region.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ማዕከላዊ ዕዝ በአንጻሩ ላይ የጣለውን ማዕቀብ ለማስፈጸም 55 የንግድ መርከቦችን አቅጣጫ እንዳስቀየረ አስታውቋል። ከዚህ በተጨማሪ ሁለት መርከቦች አገልግሎት እንዳይሰጡ መደረጉን እና ሌሎች ሁለት መርከቦችም ደንቦችን መከበራቸውን ለማረጋገጥ መፈተሻቸውን ገልጿል። እነዚህ እርምጃዎች በአካባቢው ያለውን የባህር ጉዞ በጥብቅ ለመቆጣጠር በሚደረገው ጥረት አካል ናቸው።
oromo: Ajajni giddu galeessa US, Iran irratti duula jiru kabachiisuuf jecha dooniiwwan daldala 55 karaa irraa akka maqfaman beeksisaniiru. Kana malees, dooniiwwan lama hojiin ala ta'anii fi kanneen biroo lama immoo seera eeguu isaanii mirkaneeffachuuf harka waraanaatti akka galfaman ibsameera. Tarkaanfiin kun to'annoo daandii galaana naannichaa cimsuuf kan taasifame dha.

title: Trump names Will Scharf as White House counsel ahead of midterms
english: President Donald Trump has appointed Will Scharf as his new White House counsel, effective September 1. Scharf, a former federal prosecutor and long-time legal ally, is transitioning from his role as White House staff secretary to replace the outgoing David Warrington. He is well-known for his involvement in key legal battles, including the case that established presidential immunity.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ዊል ሻርፍን አዲሱ የኋይት ሀውስ የህግ አማካሪ አድርገው ሾመዋል። ከዚህ ቀደም የኋይት ሀውስ ሰራተኞች ፀሀፊ ሆነው ሲሰሩ የነበሩት ሻርፍ፣ በመጪው መስከረም 1 ቀን ስራቸውን ይረከባሉ። የቀድሞ የፌደራል አቃቤ ህግ የሆኑት ሻርፍ፣ በፕሬዝዳንቱ የህግ ጉዳዮች ላይ በቅርበት ሲሰሩ የቆዩ ሲሆን በተለይም ለፕሬዝዳንታዊ ያለመከሰስ መብት በተደረገው ክርክር ውስጥ ትልቅ ሚና ነበራቸው።
oromo: Pireezidant Doonald Tiraamp, Wil Shaarf, gorsaa seeraa mana mootummaa (White House) haaraa ta'anii muudaniiru. Shaarf kan duraan barreessaa hojjettootaa ta'anii tajaajilaa turan, gaafa Fulbaana 1 irraa eegalee bakka Daawit Waaringitan bu'uun qabachuuf jiru. Inni duraan abukaatoo federaalaa kan turan yoo ta'u, dhimmoota seeraa Pireezidant Tiraamp irratti gumaacha guddaa gumaachaniiru, keessattuu falmii mirga ittisa pireezidantii irratti gahee murteessaa qabu.

title: Brazilian player falls into tunnel celebrating goal
english: During a Brazilian football match, player Jacy Maranhão accidentally tumbled into the stadium's tunnel while exuberantly celebrating what he thought was a goal. The situation became even more embarrassing when officials reviewed the play and determined the goal was invalid due to an offside violation. Fortunately, the incident was caught on camera, drawing significant attention to his unfortunate celebration.
amharic: በብራዚል በተደረገ የእግር ኳስ ጨዋታ ላይ ጃሲ ማራንሆ የተባለ ተጫዋች ጎል አስቆጥሬያለሁ ብሎ በደስታ ሲዘል በድንገት ወደ ተጫዋቾች መግቢያ ዋሻ ውስጥ ወድቋል። ሁኔታው ይበልጥ አሳፋሪ የሆነው ዳኞች የቪዲዮ ምርመራ ካደረጉ በኋላ ጎሉ ከጨዋታ ውጭ (ኦፍሳይድ) በመሆኑ እንዲሰረዝ ሲወስኑ ነው። ይህ አጋጣሚ በካሜራ የተቀረጸ ሲሆን በብዙዎች ዘንድ መነጋገሪያ ሆኗል።
oromo: Tapha kubbaa miilaa biyya Braazil irratti, taphataan Jaasii Maaraaniyaa jedhamu goolii nan galche jedhee gammachuun utaaluu isaa keessatti utaaltee dirree keessaa kufee gara boolla taphattoonni itti seenanitti kute. Haalli isaa kan nama qaanessu ta'ee, abbaan seeraa gooliin kun 'offside' dha jedhee erga dhiisee booda gammachuun isaa faayidaa malee hafe. Taateen kun viidiyoon kan qabame yoo ta'u, namoota hedduu biratti akka waan nama kolfisiisuutti ilaallameera.

title: Trump signals shift to economic pressure on Iran over new military strikes
english: President Donald Trump has announced that the U.S. is prioritizing economic sanctions and a naval blockade over military force to pressure Iran. By monitoring Iran's struggling economy, Washington hopes to reach a diplomatic deal while maintaining stable oil prices at home. Meanwhile, negotiations mediated by Oman are reportedly nearing an agreement to reopen shipping routes through the Strait of Hormuz.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ አሜሪካ በኢራን ላይ ወታደራዊ ኃይል ከመጠቀም ይልቅ በኢኮኖሚ ማዕቀብ እና በባህር ዳርቻ እገዳ ላይ ትኩረት እንደምታደርግ አስታውቀዋል። የኢራንን የኢኮኖሚ ድክመት በመጠቀም እና በአሜሪካ የነዳጅ ዋጋ መረጋጋትን በማረጋገጥ ለስምምነት ለመድረስ እየሰሩ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። በሌላ በኩል ኦማን በምትደራደረው ድርድር መሰረት የሆርሙዝ ስትሬትን ለመክፈት ውይይቶች ወደ መጨረሻው ምዕራፍ መድረሳቸው ተሰምቷል።
oromo: Pirezidaanti Doonaald Tiraamp akka jedhanitti, Ameerikaan dhiibbaa waraanaa irra dhiibbaa diinagdee fi uggura galaanaatti fayyadamuun Iraan waliin mariitti akka seenu gochuuf karoorfatteetti. Tiraamp akka jedhanitti, dinagdee Iraan miidhame fayyadamuun fi gatii boba'aa biyya keessaa tasgabbeessuun furmaata barbaaduuf yaalameera. Gama biraatiin, mariin Omaan giddu galeessummaan geggeessamaa jiru karaa bidiruu Hormuz deebisee banuuf gara xumuraatti dhiyaachuu gabaasameera.

title: Oil prices climb as Iranian demands cloud outlook for Strait of Hormuz
english: Global oil prices have increased as Iran refuses to reopen the Strait of Hormuz without significant concessions from the United States, including the removal of sanctions and payment of war damages. This major transit route remains largely blocked, causing severe disruptions to the international energy supply and increasing market uncertainty. Traders are becoming more anxious as the lack of a diplomatic breakthrough keeps fuel costs high.
amharic: ኢራን ማዕቀቦችን በማንሳት እና የጦርነት ካሳ በመክፈል ላይ የተመሰረቱ ቅድመ ሁኔታዎችን እስካላሟላ ድረስ የሆርሙዝ ባህረ ሰላጤን እንደማትከፍት በመግለጿ የነዳጅ ዋጋ በዓለም አቀፍ ደረጃ ጨምሯል። ይህ ወሳኝ የንግድ መስመር ዝግ ሆኖ መቆየቱ በአለም አቀፍ የኢነርጂ አቅርቦት ላይ ከፍተኛ መስተጓጎልን ፈጥሯል። ዲፕሎማሲያዊ መፍትሄ ባለመገኘቱ የነዳጅ ዋጋ ከፍተኛ ሆኖ እንዲቀጥል እና በገበያው ላይ አለመረጋጋት እንዲፈጠር አድርጓል።
oromo: Iraan meeshaalee waraanaa fi kaffaltii miidhaa waraanaa dabalatee haala adda ta'e yoo guutuufiin ala cufaa galaana Hormuz akka hin banne himuun ishee gatiin boba'aa addunyaa akka olka'u godheera. Daandiin galaana kun cufamee turuun isaa dhiyeessii anniisaa addunyaa irratti rakkoo guddaa uumeera. Furmaanni dippilomaasii dhabamuun isaa gatiin boba'aa olka'ee akka itti fufu fi gabaa keessatti yaaddoo akka uumu taasiseera.

title: Clashes in Iraq’s Kut city during protests over power shortages
english: Protests have erupted in the Iraqi city of Kut as residents express frustration over ongoing electricity shortages during extreme heat. Demonstrators gathered outside the Wasit Governorate Council to demand better power services. Security forces intervened using tear gas to manage the rising tensions.
amharic: በኢራቅ ኩት ከተማ ነዋሪዎች በከፍተኛ ሙቀት ወቅት እየተከሰተ ያለውን የኤሌክትሪክ መቆራረጥ በመቃወም አደባባይ ወጥተዋል። ተቃዋሚዎች የኤሌክትሪክ አቅርቦት እንዲሻሻል በመጠየቅ በዋሲት ገዢው ምክር ቤት ጽህፈት ቤት ፊት ለፊት ተሰብስበዋል። የጸጥታ ኃይሎችም ውጥረቱን ለመቆጣጠር አስለቃሽ ጭስ ተጠቅመዋል።
oromo: Magaalaa Kuut kan Iraaq keessatti, jiraattonni ho'a cimaa keessatti rakkoo dhabama ibsaa mormuun hiriira ba'aniiru. Namoonni hiriira ba'an kun tajaajilli ibsaa akka fooyya'u gaafachuun waajjira bulchiinsa magaalaa Wasit dura walgahaniiru. Humnoonni nageenyaa hiriiricha to'achuuf gaazii imimmaansuu fayyadamaniiru.

title: Houthi attack on Mocha kills seven, Yemeni military says
english: A Houthi drone strike on the Yemeni port city of Mocha has resulted in the deaths of seven people, including both civilians and military members. At least 30 additional individuals sustained injuries during the assault. Yemeni security forces reported that they successfully managed to neutralize 11 of the drones involved in the attack.
amharic: በየመን የሞቻ ወደብ ከተማ በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በተፈጸመ የድሮን ጥቃት ሰባት ሰዎች መሞታቸው ተገለጸ። በጥቃቱ የሲቪል እና የውትድርና አባላት የሆኑ ሰባት ሰዎች ሲገደሉ 30 ሌሎች ደግሞ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። የየመን ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች በጥቃቱ የተሳተፉ 11 ድሮኖችን መትተው መጣላቸውን አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Humni Houtii magaalaa buufata doonii Mochaa irratti raawwateen namoonni torba ajjeefamaniiru. Miidhaan kun loltootaa fi nagaa buufachuun erga gahe booda, namoonni 30 ol ta’an madaa’aniiru. Humnoonni waraana Yemen duula kana keessatti xiyyaarota nama malee balali’an 11 ta’an gadi buusuu isaanii ibsaniiru.

title: Report: Tensions deepening between US, Israel
english: Diplomatic friction is rising between the United States and Israel as Washington pushes to end ongoing military operations in Gaza, Lebanon, and Iran. During a recent visit to Israel, CENTCOM commander Brad Cooper reportedly urged Israeli officials to move toward concluding these three active fronts. This development signals a strategic push by the U.S. to de-escalate regional conflicts, despite differing priorities between the two allies.
amharic: አሜሪካ በጋዛ፣ በሊባኖስ እና በኢራን እየተካሄደ ያለውን ጦርነት ለማቆም ጥረት በማድረጓ በእሷ እና በእስራኤል መካከል ያለው ውጥረት እየጨመረ ነው። የአሜሪካ የሴንትኮም አዛዥ ብራድ ኩፐር በቅርቡ እስራኤልን በጎበኙበት ወቅት እነዚህን ሶስት ግንባሮች እንዲዘጉ ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። ይህ እርምጃ አሜሪካ በክልሉ ያለውን ግጭት ለማርገብ ያላትን ፍላጎት የሚያሳይ ቢሆንም በሁለቱ አገራት መካከል ያለውን አለመግባባት ይበልጥ ጎልቶ እንዲወጣ አድርጓል።
oromo: Amerika waraana Gaaza, Libaanoos fi Iraan keessatti gaggeeffamaa jiru dhaabuuf carraaqqii gochaa jirtuun wal qabatee, walitti dhufeenyi ishee fi Israa’el gidduu jiru hammaachaa dhufeera. Ajajaan RIB (CENTCOM) Birad Kuupar torbee kana Israa'elitti imala taasisaniin, waraana kana sadan dhaabuuf dhiibbaa gochuun gabaasameera. Tarkaanfiin kun Amerikaan gurguddina waraana naannichaa hir'isuuf akka barbaaddu kan agarsiisu ta'us, garaagarummaan yaadaa gidduu biyyoota lamaanii dabaluu isaa ibsameera.

title: Alleged Irish crime boss Daniel Kinahan in court after Dubai extradition
english: Daniel Kinahan, a suspected Irish crime leader, has appeared in a Dublin court following his extradition from Dubai. The 49-year-old faces serious charges related to his role in managing a criminal organization. He had previously been considered one of the most sought-after individuals by international law enforcement agencies.
amharic: የአየርላንዳዊው የወንጀለኞች ቡድን መሪ ተብሎ የሚጠረጠረው ዳንኤል ኪናሃን ከዱባይ ወደ አየርላንድ ተላልፎ ከተሰጠ በኋላ በደብሊን ፍርድ ቤት ቀረበ። የ49 ዓመቱ ግለሰብ ወንጀለኛ ድርጅትን በበላይነት የመራ ተብሎ ተከሷል። ቀደም ሲል በአለም አቀፍ የፖሊስ ተቋማት በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ ሲፈለግ የነበረ ግለሰብ ነው።
oromo: Hoggansa garee yakkaa kan biyya Aayerlaand ta'uu shakkamee kan jiru Daani'eel Kiinahaan, biyya Dubaay irraa gara biyya isaatti ergamee booda mana murtii Dubliin dhiyaateera. Namni umriin isaa 49 ta'e kun, dhaabbata yakkaa hordofuun kan himatame yoo ta'u, kanaan dura qaamolee seera kabachiistota addunyaatiin cimaatti barbaadamaa ture.

title: Houthis launch fresh ballistic missile and drone attacks on al-Makha port
english: The Houthi group has carried out new attacks on the Yemeni port of al-Makha using a combination of ballistic missiles and drones. These strikes targeted weapons storage facilities connected to Saudi Arabia. According to reports from the Yemeni military, the assault resulted in the deaths of at least seven individuals.
amharic: የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በየመን አል-ማካ ወደብ ላይ በባሊስቲክ ሚሳኤሎች እና በድሮኖች ጥቃት ፈጽመዋል። ጥቃቱ ሳዑዲ አረቢያን የሚደግፉ የጦር መሳሪያ ማከማቻዎችን ያነጣጠረ ነበር። የየመን ወታደራዊ መግለጫ እንዳመለከተው፣ በደረሰው ጥቃት ቢያንስ ሰባት ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል።
oromo: Gareen Hutiin buufata doonii Al-Makha kan Yaman irratti weerara haarawaa meeshaalee waraanaa fi xiyyara maleeyyii (droniin) fayyadamuun geggeesseera. Weerarchi kun meeshaalee waraanaa kanneen Sa'udii Arabiyaan deeggaramanitti xiyyeeffateera. Gabaasni waraana Yaman akka ibsetti, miidhaa kanaan lubbuun namoota torba ta'uu akka darbe beekameera.

title: Could Morocco’s football chief Fouzi Lekjaa become its next prime minister?
english: Fouzi Lekjaa, a prominent Moroccan official known for his work in finance and football, has joined the Authenticity and Modernity Party ahead of the September parliamentary elections. His entry into partisan politics has sparked widespread discussion about his future, with many speculating he could be a candidate for prime minister. This shift highlights a growing focus on managerial experience, as the next government will be responsible for overseeing the country’s preparations for the 2030 World Cup.
amharic: በሞሮኮ የገንዘብ ሚኒስትር እና የֆուትቦል ፌዴሬሽን ፕሬዝዳንት የሆኑት ፋውዚ ሌክጃ፣ በመጪው መስከረም በሚካሄደው ምርጫ ከመሳተፋቸው በፊት በቅርቡ በአንድ የፖለቲካ ፓርቲ ውስጥ አባል መሆናቸው ከፍተኛ ውይይት ቀስቅሷል። ይህ ውሳኔ ብዙዎች የሀገሪቱ ቀጣይ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ሊሆኑ እንደሚችሉ እንዲገምቱ አድርጓቸዋል። የሚመጣው መንግስት የ2030 የዓለም ዋንጫ ዝግጅትን የመምራት ኃላፊነት ስላለበት፣ የአስተዳደር ልምድ ያላቸው ሰዎች መኖራቸው ትልቅ ቦታ ተሰጥቶታል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni biyya Morookoo kanneen akka ministira bajataa fi pirezidaantii federeeshinii kubbaa miilaa, Foozi Leekjaa, filannoo gara fuulduraatti gaggeeffamuun dura paartii siyaasaa tokkotti makamuun isaanii marii guddaa uumee jira. Tarkaanfiin kun namoonni hedduun inni gara fuulduraatti muummee ministiraa biyyattii ta'uu danda'a jedhanii akka yaadan godhee jira. Mootummaan dhufu qophii Waancaa Addunyaa bara 2030 hordofuu fi hogganuu waan qabuuf, namoonni dandeettii bulchiinsa qaban xiyyeeffannoo argataa jiru.

title: Watch: Netanyahu says Israel 'rejects' Trump's 15-point plan for Gaza
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has officially dismissed a 15-point peace proposal for Gaza supported by President Donald Trump. He insisted that Israeli forces will remain in the territory and will not retreat until Hamas is completely disarmed. Netanyahu emphasized that his military will continue its operations to protect citizens and neutralize security threats.
amharic: የእስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ በፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የተደገፈውን የ15 ነጥብ የጋዛ ሰላም እቅድ በይፋ ውድቅ አድርገዋል። ሐማስ ሙሉ በሙሉ ትጥቅ እስካልፈታ ድረስ የእስራኤል ወታደሮች ከጋዛ እንደማይወጡ አስታውቀዋል። በተጨማሪም የእስራኤል ጦር የሀገሪቱን ዜጎች ደህንነት ለመጠበቅና ስጋቶችን ለማስወገድ ኦፕሬሽኑን እንደሚቀጥል ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Mummichi Ministeera Israa'el Benyamin Netanyaahuu karoora nageenyaa Gaazaa kan qabxii 15 of keessaa qabuufi Preezidaant Doonaald Tiraamp deggaran sana guutummaatti didaniiru. Hamni hanga hidhannoo isaa hiikutti waraanni Israa'el naannichaa gadhiisee akka hin baane ibsaniiru. Netanyaahuun waraanni isaanii nageenya lammiilee eeguufi sodaawwan isaan mudatan ittisuuf duula isaanii itti fufsiisuu akka barbaadan mirkaneessaniiru.

title: Lebanon will not take part in next talks with Israel unless demands met: Report
english: Lebanon has announced it will refuse to attend the upcoming September negotiations with Israel unless its specific requirements are fulfilled. The Lebanese government is demanding a complete cease-fire and the immediate cessation of Israeli military construction and destruction activities. Consequently, the schedule for any future talks remains uncertain as Beirut awaits a formal response from Israel regarding these terms.
amharic: ሊባኖስ የኢራኤል ጥያቄዎች እስካልተሟሉ ድረስ በመስከረም ወር ሊካሄድ የታቀደው የድርድር ሂደት እንደማትሳተፍ አስታውቃለች። ሊባኖስ ተኩስ ሙሉ በሙሉ እንዲቆም እና የእስራኤል ጦር የሚያካሂደው የግንባታና የጥፋት ስራ እንዲቆም ቅድመ ሁኔታ አስቀምጣለች። እነዚህ ቅድመ ሁኔታዎች እስካልተመለሱ ድረስ የድርድሩ ቀጠሮ እርግጠኛ ባልሆነ ሁኔታ ላይ ይገኛል።
oromo: Libanoon yoo gaaffiileen ishee hin guutamne ta'e, marii Isiraa'el waliin ji'a Fulbaanaatti taasifamuuf karoorfame irratti hirmaachuu akka hin barbaanne ibsiteetti. Mootummaan Libaanoos dhukaasa dhaabuu fi waraanni Isiraa'el hojiiwwan diiggaa fi ijaarsa lafa irraatti gaggeessu akka dhaabu gaafachaa jirti. Hanga Isiraa'el haala kanneen irratti waliigaltee kennitutti, guyyaan marii gara fuulduraa kan murtaa'e miti.

title: Israeli attacks in south Lebanon continue, despite truce talks
english: Despite ongoing ceasefire negotiations, Israeli military forces have persisted with artillery and aerial strikes across southern Lebanon. These recent attacks have hit several towns, causing significant destruction. Since March, the conflict has resulted in over 4,300 deaths and more than 12,000 injuries among the Lebanese population.
amharic: የተኩስ አቁም ድርድሮች እየተካሄዱ ቢሆንም፣ የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች በደቡብ ሊባኖስ ላይ የሚሰነዝሩትን የከባድ መሳሪያ እና የአየር ጥቃት ቀጥለዋል። እነዚህ ጥቃቶች በተለያዩ የሊባኖስ ከተሞች ላይ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት አድርሰዋል። ከማርች ወር ወዲህ በተፈጸሙት የእስራኤል ጥቃቶች ከ4,300 በላይ ሰዎች ሲገደሉ ከ12,000 በላይ የሚሆኑት ደግሞ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል።
oromo: Hanga ammaa mariin tasgabii biyyoota lamaan gidduutti godhamaa jiraatus, waraanni Israa'el kibba Libaanoos irratti haleellaa miilaa fi qilleensa irraa itti fufee jira. Haleellaan kunneen magaalota garaagaraa rukutuun miidhaa hamaa geessisaniiru. Ji'a Bitootessaa irraa jalqabee haleellaa Israa'el kanaan namootni 4,300 ol du'anii, namootni 12,000 ol ta'an immoo madaa'aniiru.

title: Israel rejects Trump's 15-point plan for Gaza, says Netanyahu
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has formally rejected a 15-point peace proposal for Gaza promoted by Donald Trump. Netanyahu stated that Israel will refuse to pull its forces out of the region until Hamas completely gives up its arms. Despite earlier reports suggesting both parties had agreed to the plan, ongoing military strikes continue as the Israeli government stands firm on its security requirements.
amharic: የእስራኤል ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ በዶናልድ ትራምፕ ቀርቦ የነበረውን የ15 ነጥብ የጋዛ ሰላም እቅድ ውድቅ አድርገዋል። ሀማስ ሙሉ በሙሉ ትጥቅ እስካልፈታ ድረስ እስራኤል ወታደሮቿን ከጋዛ እንደማታስወጣ ኔታንያሁ አስታውቀዋል። ቀደም ሲል በሁለቱ ወገኖች ስምምነት ላይ እንደተደረሰ ቢነገርም እስራኤል ወታደራዊ እርምጃዋን እንደምትቀጥል ግልጽ ሆኗል።
oromo: Mummichi Ministeera Israa'el Benyamin Netanyaahuun sagantaa nagaa Gaazaaf dhiyaate kan qabxii 15 of keessatti qabatu kan Donald Traamp durfamuufi mormaniiru. Netanyaahuun hamma Hamas guutummaatti meeshaa waraanaa hiikutti Israa'el waraana ishee Gaazaa keessaa akka hin baafne ibsaniiru. Kanaan dura garuun lamaanuu walii galuu isaanii kan gabaafame ta'us, Israa'el tarkaanfii waraanaa ishee itti fufuuf murteessiteetti.

title: Everyday Authoritarianism Threatens Ethiopia’s Democratic Ambitions
english: Ethiopia's struggle with democracy is rooted in a cultural tendency to view authority as a tool for dominance rather than cooperation. From households to schools and workplaces, society often encourages unquestioning obedience, where dissent is frequently mistaken for disloyalty. This deeply embedded social pattern limits democratic growth by teaching individuals to prioritize submission and hierarchy over open dialogue.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ የዴሞክራሲ ፈተና ሥር የሰደደው ስልጣንን ለትብብር ሳይሆን ለ የበላይነት የመጠቀም ባህል ነው። ከቤተሰብ ጀምሮ እስከ ትምህርት ቤቶችና የስራ ቦታዎች ድረስ፣ ማህበረሰቡ ጥያቄ ሳያነሱ መታዘዝን የሚያበረታታ ሲሆን፣ የተለየ አስተያየት መኖር እንደ ታማኝነት ማጉደል ይቆጠራል። ይህ በህብረተሰቡ ውስጥ የገባው የአስተሳሰብ ዘይቤ፣ ግለሰቦች ግልጽ ውይይትን ከመተግበር ይልቅ ለስልጣን መገዛትን እንዲያቀድሙ በማድረግ የዴሞክራሲን እድገት ይገድባል።
oromo: Rakkoon demokraasii Itoophiyaa keessatti mul'atu aadaa aangoo akka meeshaa ittiin wal-caaluu fi ajajuutti fayyadamu malee, akka meeshaa waliin hojjechuutti ilaaluu dadhabuurraa madda. Mana jireenyaa, mana barnootaa fi bakka hojiitti, hawaasni namoota akka waan hundumaa tole jedhanii fudhatanitti waan jajjabeessuuf, yaada mormii dhiyyeessuu akka amanamummaa dhabuutti ilaalama. Akkaataan itti yaadaa hawaasaa kun, namoonni marii banuu mannaa aangoo fi sadarkaaf jedhanii akka garraamifatan waan taasisuuf, guddinni demokraasii akka daangeffamu taasisa.

title: Evidence that South African special forces murdered top detective shared with BBC
english: Eight South African military personnel have been accused of murdering high-ranking detective Frans Mathipa, who was shot while investigating sensitive cases involving special forces. Evidence obtained by the BBC suggests that military-linked vehicles tracked the detective shortly before his death. Despite the gravity of the charges, legal proceedings have stalled as some suspects remain in their military positions, raising concerns about potential interference and a lack of accountability.
amharic: ስምንት የደቡብ አፍሪካ ወታደራዊ አባላት ከፍተኛውን መርማሪ ፍራንስ ማቲፓን በመግደል ተከሰሱ። መርማሪው ለልዩ ኃይሎች ጉዳይ ምርመራ ሲያደርጉ እንደነበረ እና በዚህ ሂደት ላይ እያሉ እንደተገደሉ ይነገራል። የቢቢሲ ዘገባ እንደሚያሳየው ወታደራዊ ተሽከርካሪዎች መርማሪውን ተከታትለው እንደነበር ማስረጃዎች አሉ። ምንም እንኳን ክሱ ከባድ ቢሆንም ተከሳሾቹ አሁንም በወታደራዊ ስራቸው ላይ በመሆናቸው ፍትህ ሊጓተት ይችላል የሚል ስጋት ተፈጥሯል።
oromo: miseensonni waraana Afrikaa Kibbaa saddeet, qorataa olaanaa Frans Maatipaatti ajjeesaniiru jedhamanii shakkamu. Maatipaatti dhimmoota humnoota addaa waliin walqabataniin qorannaa adeemsisaa utuu jiruu ajjeefame. Ragaan BBC gahe tokko akka agarsiisutti, konkolaataan waraanaa duukaa bu'ee isa hordofaa akka ture mirkaneessu. Himannichi cimaa ta'us, shakkamtoonni kun ammas hojii waraanaa irra waan jiraniif, haqni akka hin argamne sodaan jira.

title: Houthis renew missile and drone attacks on Yemen’s port of al-Makha
english: Houthi forces have conducted a series of missile and drone strikes against the Yemeni port city of al-Makha, resulting in at least 11 deaths and significant damage to commercial infrastructure. These back-to-back attacks targeted areas held by the government, with the Houthis claiming they were in response to a military buildup by Saudi-backed forces. Government authorities reported intercepting several drones and missiles, while calling on local residents to stay inside for safety as the situation remains volatile.
amharic: የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በየመን አል-መኻ ወደብ ከተማ ላይ በተከታታይ የሚሳኤል እና የድሮን ጥቃት አድርሰዋል። ጥቃቱ ቢያንስ 11 ሰዎችን የገደለ ሲሆን በወደቡ መሠረተ ልማት እና በንግድ ተቋማት ላይ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት አድርሷል። ሁቲዎች ጥቃቱን የፈጸሙት የሳውዲ ደጋፊ ኃይሎች በምዕራብ የመን ወታደራዊ ዝግጅት እያደረጉ ነው በሚል ሰበብ ነው። የየመን መንግሥት ኃይሎች ጥቃቱን ለመመከት ቢሞክሩም፣ ግጭቱ በአካባቢው ያለውን የጸጥታ ሁኔታ አባብሶታል።
oromo: Humnoonni Houthi magaalaa fi buufata doonii Yemen kan taate al-Makha irratti haleellaa misa'elaa fi doonii qilleensaa (drone) gaggeessaniiru. Haleellaa kana hordofee lubbuun namoota 11 darbee, miidhaan guddaanis qabeenyaa fi buufata daldalaa irratti ga'eera. Houthin haleellaa kana kan raawwatan humnoota Sa'udii deggaraman waliin wal-qabsiisudhaan ta'uus, mootummaan Yemen gama isaatiin haleellicha ittisuuf carraaqqii gochaa jira. Haala kana hordofee, jiraattonni naannichaa tasgabbii akka eeggatan fi manatti akka turan gorfamaniiru.

title: Iran war live: US ‘semi-negotiating’ with Tehran; Israel rejects Gaza plan
english: President Trump stated that the US is only partially engaging in talks with Iran, preferring to rely on growing economic pressure. Meanwhile, Iranian officials deny any direct negotiations and maintain that the Strait of Hormuz will remain closed until their specific demands are met. Additionally, Israel has formally turned down a proposed peace initiative for Gaza.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ አሜሪካ ከኢራን ጋር በከፊል ብቻ እየተደራደረች እንደሆነ እና በኢኮኖሚያዊ ጫና ውጤት ለማምጣት እየጠበቁ መሆናቸውን ገልጸዋል። የኢራን ባለስልጣናት በበኩላቸው ምንም አይነት ቀጥተኛ ንግግር እንደሌለ በመግለጽ፣ የሆርሙዝ ባህር ሰላጤ እስከሚጠየቁት የኢኮኖሚ እፎይታዎች ድረስ ተዘግቶ እንደሚቆይ አረጋግጠዋል። ከዚህ በተጨማሪም እስራኤል ለጋዛ የቀረበውን የሰላም እቅድ ውድቅ አድርጋለች።
oromo: Pirezedaanti Traamp akka jedhanitti, Yuunisni Ameerikaa Iran waliin marii gadi fageenya hin qabne kan taasisaa jirtu yoo ta'u, dhiibbaa diinagdee irra caalu uumuuf eegaa jiru. Gammachuu biraatiin, qondaalonni Iran mariin kallattii tokko illee akka hin jirre ibsuun, hanga fedhiin isaanii guututti daandiin galaana Hormuz cufaa akka ta'u mirkaneessaniiru. Kana malees, Israa'el karoora nagaa Gaazaaf dhiyaate guutummaatti diddeetti.

title: F-16s intercept two aircraft near Trump’s New Jersey golf club
english: US fighter jets were scrambled to intercept two civilian planes that flew into unauthorized airspace near a golf course in New Jersey. At the time of the incident, former President Donald Trump was present at the property attending a tournament. Officials from NORAD confirmed that the military aircraft intervened to address the safety breach in the restricted area.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የጦር አውሮፕላኖች በኒው ጀርሲ በሚገኘው የዶናልድ ትራምፕ ጎልፍ ሜዳ አቅራቢያ በተከለከለ የአየር ክልል ውስጥ የገቡ ሁለት ሲቪል አውሮፕላኖችን አቋርጠው አስቆሙ። ክስተቱ በተከሰተበት ወቅት የቀድሞው ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በቦታው ተገኝተው ውድድር እየተመለከቱ ነበር። የሰሜን አሜሪካ የአየር መከላከያ ዕዝ (NORAD) እንደገለጸው፣ የጦር አውሮፕላኖቹ በክልከላው አካባቢ የተፈጠረውን የደህንነት ጥሰት ለመቆጣጠር ጣልቃ ገብተዋል።
oromo: Xiyyaarotni waraana Ameerikaa xiyyaarota sivilii lama kanneen iddoo golfii Donald Trump, New Jerseyitti argamu kan hayyama hin qabne cabsanii seenan hordofuun dhaabsisaniiru. Yeroo kana duraani pirezidaant Donald Trump iddoo sanatti tapha tokko hordofaa turan. Abbootiin taayitaa ittisa qilleensaa kan NORAD akka ibsanitti, xiyyaarotni waraana kun bakka dhorkaa ta'e sana keessatti nageenyi akka hin boorofneef tarkaanfii fudhataniiru.

title: Union reports 108 attacks on Palestinian journalists in July
english: The Palestinian Journalists Syndicate recorded 108 separate attacks on media workers by Israeli forces and settlers during July in the occupied West Bank. These violations included physical assaults, arbitrary detentions, the destruction of equipment, and the obstruction of reporting activities. This recent spike in violence contributes to a broader, historic trend that has seen over 270 journalists killed since October 2023.
amharic: የፍልስጤም ጋዜጠኞች ማህበር በሐምሌ ወር ብቻ በእስራኤል ኃይሎች እና በሰፋሪዎች የተፈጸሙ 108 የጥቃት ድርጊቶችን መዝግቧል። እነዚህ ጥሰቶች አካላዊ ጥቃትን፣ ያለ አግባብ ማሰርን፣ የመገናኛ ብዙሃን መሳሪያዎችን ማውደምን እና የጋዜጠኝነት ስራን ማደናቀፍን ያካትታሉ። ይህ የቅርብ ጊዜ የጥቃት ጭማሪ ከጥቅምት 2023 ጀምሮ ከ270 በላይ ጋዜጠኞች ለህልፈት የተዳረጉበትን አሳዛኝ ታሪካዊ ክስተት የሚያጠናክር ነው።
oromo: Gamtaan Gaazexeessitoota Palastiinii akka gabaasetti, ji'a Adooleessa keessa qofaa humnoota Israa'elii fi qonnattootaan gaazexeessitoota irratti haleellaan 108 raawwatameera. Haleellaan kunneen reebicha, hidhaa seeran alaa, meeshaalee hojii mancaasuu fi hojii gabaasaa gufachiisuu kan dabalatuudha. Daballiin haleellaa kanaa, erga Adoolessa 2023 as gaazexeessitoonni 270 ol ajjeefamuu isaanii waliin walqabatee, haalli kun yeroo hunda caalaa gaazexeessitootaaf kan sodaachisu ta'uu agarsiisa.

title: What’s driving unrest in Pakistan-administered Kashmir?
english: Pakistan-administered Kashmir is currently experiencing significant political instability and fatal demonstrations. These protests are occurring during a critical period leading up to the final stage of regional elections. The unrest highlights deep-seated tensions within the disputed territory.
amharic: በፓኪስታን አስተዳደር ስር ባለው ካሽሚር ክልል ከባድ የፖለቲካ ቀውስ እና ገዳይ ተቃውሞዎች እየተካሄዱ ይገኛሉ። እነዚህ ተቃውሞዎች በክልሉ እየተካሄደ ያለው የምርጫ ሂደት የመጨረሻ ዙር እየተቃረበ ባለበት ወቅት የተቀሰቀሱ ናቸው። የዚህ ቀውስ መንስኤም በክልሉ ውስጥ ባለው ረዘም ያለ የፖለቲካ አለመረጋጋት እና ውጥረት የተነሳ ነው።
oromo: Naannoo Kaashmiir kan Paakistaan bulchaa jirtu keessatti rakkoon siyaasaa cimaafi hiriirri lubbuu galaafate mudachaa jira. Hiriirri kun kan ta'e adeemsa filannoo naannichaa xumura irra ga'e dura. Rakkoon kunis sababa gaaffiiwwan siyaasaa naannichaa keessatti walxaxaa ta'anii fi tasgabbii dhabuu irraa kan maddeedha.

title: Trump shares Clinton defence of Gaza plan after Netanyahu rejects roadmap
english: President Trump recently shared an opinion piece by Hillary Clinton that supports his Gaza peace proposal. This move comes shortly after Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu officially rejected the plan. While Trump publicized the endorsement, he has not yet commented on Netanyahu's decision or indicated how the US might respond.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ የጋዛ የሰላም ዕቅዳቸውን የሚደግፍ የሂላሪ ክሊንተን ጽሁፍ በማህበራዊ ሚዲያቸው ላይ አጋርተዋል። ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው የእስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ የትራምፕን ዕቅድ ውድቅ ካደረጉ በኋላ ነው። ትራምፕ ይህን ድጋፍ ቢያሳዩም፣ ስለ ኔታንያሁ ውሳኔ ወይም በአሜሪካ መንግስት ቀጣይ እርምጃ ላይ እስካሁን የሰጡት አስተያየት የለም።
oromo: Pireezidaant Traamp yaada Hillary Clinton kan karoora isaanii kan gaza deggeru miidiyaarratti qoodaniiru. Tarkaanfin kun kan fudhatame erga Muummichi Ministiraa Israa'el Benjamin Netanyahu karoora kana fudhachuu didanii boodadha. Traamp deggersa kana kan ibsan ta'us, murtii Netanyahu irratti ykn tarkaanfii mootummaan Ameerikaa gara fuulduraatti fudhatu irratti hanga ammaatti waan tokko hin jedhani.

title: Board of Peace envoy says Israel not required to withdraw from Gaza
english: A senior envoy from the Board of Peace has clarified that Israel is not obligated to pull its troops out of Gaza until Palestinian factions successfully disarm. This new stance follows Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s rejection of the proposed peace roadmap, as he insists on maintaining the right to conduct military strikes. The verification process for disarmament will be overseen by the United States with assistance from Turkey and Qatar.
amharic: የሰላም ቦርድ ከፍተኛ ተወካይ እስራኤል የፍልስጤም ቡድኖች ትጥቃቸውን እስኪፈቱ ድረስ ከጋዛ ወታደሮቿን የማስወጣት ግዴታ እንደሌለባት ገልጸዋል። ይህ አቋም የመጣው የእስራኤሉ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ የሰላም ዕቅዱን ውድቅ በማድረጋቸው እና ወታደራዊ እርምጃ የመውሰድ መብታቸውን በማረጋገጣቸው ነው። የትጥቅ መፍታት ሂደቱ በአሜሪካ ቁጥጥር ስር ሆኖ በቱርክ እና በኳታር ድጋፍ የሚከናወን ይሆናል።
